a: Vei bae zarek, vekatane deeno metamme tumeat ochalin. may lav defaygel bizrika? la, defaygel bishchita.
Aval paygel bizrika, may? hachi name dimtamme tumeat ochalin.
Addetane piggel bemincha metamme tumeat ochalin, liflog bedida, bamme devarim amurim? defaygel bishchita, aval paygel bizrika – metamme tumeat ochalin!
Piggel bemincha itztericha leh, deaf al gav defaygel bikmitza, dekometz bemincha kishchita dame, afillu hachi – metamme tumeat ochalin, hoil vehayta lo sheat hakkosher meikkaro.
Amar rav ashe: amrita lishmata kammeh derav nachman, afillu tema lan mammash, vaafillu tema defaygel bizrika.
Dei bae parek – amrinan, i bae hava zarek – la amrinan.
Metivi, kelal amar rabbi yehoshua: kol shehayta lah sheat hetter lakkohanim – en moalin bah, vechol shello hayta lah sheat hetter lakkohanim – moalin bah.
Veezehu sheat hetter lakkohanim? shellana, veshennitmet, vesheyyatza.
Veezo hi shello hayta lah sheat hetter lakkohanim? shennishchata chutz lizmannah, vechutz limkomah, veshekkibbelu pesulin vezarku et damah.
Katane miha resha shellana, veshennitmet, vesheyyatza. may lav lana mammash, vehacha dei bae hava zarek hu, vekatane deen moalin.
La, reuya latzet, ureuya littamme, ureuya lalin.
Aval lina mammash, may? hachi name demoalin! hay "kol (shehaya) [shehayta] lah sheat hetter lakkohanim" vechol shello hayta lah sheat hetter lakkohanim"?
"Kol sheyyesh lah sheat hetter lakkohanim en moalin bah", vechol sheen lah sheat hetter lakkohanim moalin bah" mibbee leh!
Ella amar rav ashe: meila attumea ka ramet?
Meila mishshum kedushsha velav kedushsha hi, levatar defaka la kedushsheteh, bemay hadra rachva la?

Tumea mishshum uchela velav (mishshum) uchela hi, kol hecha dei bae zarek matze zarek leh – meshavve leh uchela, umetamme tumeat ochalin. hecha dei bae (matze) zarek la matze zarek – la meshavve leh uchela, [vela] metamme tumeat ochalin.
Metivi: hammevi asham taluy, venoda shello chata – im ad shello nishchat noda lo, yetze veyire baeder, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim:
b: Yire ad sheyyistaev veyimmacher veyippelu damav lindava. rabbi eliezer omer: yakriv, sheim eno ba al chet ze hare hu ba al chet acher.
Mishshennishchat, noda lo – haddam yishshafech, vehabbasar yissaref.
Nizrak haddam – habbasar yeachel, verabbi yose omer: afillu haddam bakkos – yizzarek vehabbasar yeachel.
Veamar rava: rabbi yose beshitat rabbi shimon amarah, deamar: kol haomed lizrok – kezaruk dame.
Midde hu tama? amri bemareva mishshemeh derabbi yose bar chanina: hayeynu tama derabbi yose, dekasavar kele sharet mekaddeshin et happesulin lechattechilla likrav.

Amar leh rav ashe lerav kahana: middeamar rabbi shimon kol haomed lizrok kezaruk dame, kol haomed lisrof name kesaruf dame – notar ufara ammay mittammein tumeat ochalin? afra bealma ninhu! amar leh: chibbat hakkodesh machshartan.
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: nehi demahneya lehu chibbat hakkodesh leippesole degufeh, likkeroye tame name, lemimne beh rishon vesheni?
Tifshot devae resh lakish: tzarid shel menachot, monin bo rishon vesheni, o en monin bo rishon vesheni?
Ki mibbaya leh leresh lakish – deorayyta, ki kaamrinan – derabbanan.
Mishna haomer "hare alay bemachavat" vehevi bemarcheshet, "bemarcheshet" vehevi bemachavat – ma shehevi hevi, vide chovato lo yatza.
"Zo lehavi bemachavat", vehevi bemarcheshet; "bemarcheshet", vehevi bemachavat – hare zo pesula.
Haomer: "hare alay shene esronot lehavi bichli echad", vehevi bishne kelim, "bishne kelim", vehevi bichli echad – ma shehevi hevi, vide chovato lo yatza.
"Ellu bichli echad", vehevi bishne kelim; "bishne kelim", vehevi bichli echad – hare ellu pesulin.
"Hare alay shene esronot lehavi bichli echad", vehevi bishne kelim, amru lo: "bichli echad nadarta". hikrivan bishne kelim – pesulin, bichli echad – kesherin.
"Hare alay shene esronot lehavi bishne kelim", vehevi bichli echad, amru lo: "bishne kelim nadarta". hikrivan bishne kelim – kesherin, netano lichli echad – kishte menachot shennitarvu.
Gemara utzericha.
Dei ashmeinan hach kammayyta, mishshum deamar "bemachavat" veka mayyte bemarcheshet, aval hacha deidde veidde bemachavat, veidde veidde bemarcheshet, ema yede nidro name yatza.
Vei ashmeinan hach, mishshum deka paleg laho, aval hatam dela paleg beh – ema la. tzericha.
Tanu rabbanan: ma shehevi – hevi, vide nidro lo yatza. rabbi shimon omer: af yede nidro name yatza.
Zo lehavi bemachavat – veha tanya: lo kiddeshum kele sharet? amar abbaye: lo kiddeshum likrav, aval kiddeshum lippasel.
Veamar abbaye: lo shanu

a: Ella shekkevaan bishat neder, aval bishat haferasha – la.
"Kaasher nadarta", velo "kaasher hifrashta".
Ittemar name: amar rabbi acha bar chanina, amar rabbi assi, amar rabbi yochanan: lo shanu ella shekkevaan bishat neder, aval bishat haferasha – lo, "kaasher nadarta" velo "kaasher hifrashta".
Mishna haomer "hare alay mincha min hasseorim" – yavi min hachittim. "kemach" – yavi solet. "belo shemen uvelo levona" – yavi shemen ulevona.
"Chatzi issaron" – yavi issaron shalem, "issaron umechetza" – yavi shenayim, rabbi shimon poter, shello hitnaddev kederech hammitnaddevin.
Gemara ammay? neder ufitcho immo hu!
Amar chizkiyya: ha manni? bet shammay hi, deamri tefos lashon rishon, ditnan: "hareni nazir min haggerogrot umin haddevela" – bet shammay omrim: nazir, uvet hillel omrim: eno nazir.
Rabbi yochanan amar: afillu tema bet hillel, beomer "illu hayiti yodea sheen nodrin kach, lo hayiti noder kach ella kach".
Amar chizkiyya: lo shanu ella deamar "mincha min hasseorim", aval amar "mincha min haadashim" – la.
Mikkedi chizkiyya keman amar lishmateh? kevet shammay, uvet shammay mishshum tefos lashon rishon hu. ma li min hasseorin, ma li min haadashim? hadar beh.
Umay tama hadar beh? amar rava: matnitin keshiteh, may irya detane "mincha min hasseorim"? litne "min haadashim"!
Ella shema minna, mishshum detae hu, bisorim tae, baadashim la tae.
Verabbi yochanan amar: afillu min haadashim. mikkede, rabbi yochanan keman amra lishmateh? kevet hillel, uvet hillel mishshum detae hu. bisorin – tae, baadashim – la tae!
Lidvarav dechizkiyya kaamar leh, at may tama hadrat bach mishshum dela katane "min haadashim".

Dilma "la mibbaya" kaamar, la mibbaya min haadashim, deikka lememar mihdar hu dehadar beh, utefos lashon rishon, ella afillu min hasseorin name, deikka lememar mita hu deka tae, afillu hachi tefos lashon rishon.
b: Amar zeeri: lo shanu ella deamar "mincha", aval la amar "mincha" – la.
Yatev rav nachman vekaamar la leha shemata. etiveh rava lerav nachman: "kemach" – yavi solet, lav delo amar "mincha"? la, deamar "mincha".
"Belo shemen ulevona", yavi shemen ulevona. may lav delo amar "mincha"? la, deamar "mincha".
"Chatzi issaron" – yavi issaron shalem, may lav delo amar "mincha"? la, deamar "mincha".
I hachi, ema sefa: issaron umechetza – yavi shenayim, kevan deamar "mincha" ichayyayv leh beissaron, ki amar "chatzi issaron" lo kelum kaamar hu.

La tzericha deamar "hare alay mincha chatzi issaron veissaron", dechevan deamar "mincha" ichayyayv leh beissaron, ki amar "chatzi issaron" velo kelum kaamar, ki hadar amar "issaron" mayyte issaron acharina.
I hachi, rabbi shimon poter shello hitnaddev kederech hammitnaddevin, ammay? amar rava: rabbi shimon beshitat rabbi yose amarah, deamar: af bigmar devarav adam matpis.

Mishna mitnaddev adam mincha shel shishshim issaron, umevi bichli echad. (im amar "hare alay shishshim issaron" – mevi bichli echad). im amar "hare alay shishshim veechad" – mevi shishshim bichli echad, veechad bichli echad, shekken hatztzibbur mevi beyom tov harishon shel chag shechal lihyot bashshabbat shishshim veechad.
Dayyo layyachid shehu pachot min hatztzibbur echad.
Amar rabbi shimon: vahalo ellu lapparim, veellu lakkevasim, veenam nivlalim ze im ze! ella ad shishshim yecholin libbalel.
Amru lo: shishshim nivlalin, veshishshim veechad en nivlalin?! amar lahem: kol middot chachamim ken – bearbaim sea hu tovel, uvearbaim sea chaser kurtov eno yachol litbol bahen.
Gemara sheil sheela lemala merabbi yehuda bar ilay: minnayin leomer "hare alay shishshim veechad" mevi shishshim bichli echad, veechad bichli echad?

Patach rabbi yehuda bar ilay, rosh hamedabberim bechol makom, veamar: shekken matzinu tzibbur meviin beyom tov harishon shel chag shechal lihyot bashshabbat shishshim veechad, dayyo layyachid sheyyifchot min hatztzibbur echad.
Amar lo rabbi shimon: vahalo ellu parim veelim, veellu kevasim? ellu belilatan ava, veellu belilatan rakka, ellu belilatan shacharit, veellu belilatan ben haarbayim, veen nivlalin mizze al ze.
Amru lo: "emor atta". amar lahem: hare hu omer "vechol mincha velula vashshemen vachareva", kevar amra tora: have mincha sheyyechola lehibbalel.
Amar lo: beshishshim nivlalin, beshishshim veechad en nivlalin?! amar lo: kol middat chachamim ken hu – bearbaim sea hu tovel, bearbaim sea chaser kurtov eno yachol litbol.
Kevetza – metamme tumeat ochalin, kevetza chaser shumeshum – en metamme tumeat ochalin. shelosha al shelosha – metamme midras, shelosha al shelosha chaser nima achat – eno metamme midras.
Vechi en nivlalin, may have? veha tenan: im lo balal – kasher! amar rabbi zera: kol harauy levilla – en billa meakkevet bo, vechol sheeno rauy levilla – billa meakkevet bo.
Amar rabbi bivi, amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: maase befirda achat shel bet rabbi shemmeta, veshiaru chachamim et damah birviit.

Metiv rabbi yitzchak bar bisna: heid rabbi yehoshua verabbi yehoshua ben betera al dam nevelot shehu tahor, veamar rabbi yehoshua ben betera: maase vehayu nocharin arodyaot laarayot beistarya shel melech, vehayu ole regalim shokin ad rechubbotehen baddam, velo amru lahem davar.
Ishtik, amar leh rabbi zerika: may tama la ka mahdar mar? amar leh: hechi ahdar leh, deamar rabbi chanin: "vehayu chayyecha teluim lecha minneged" – ze hallokeach tevua mishshana leshana.
"Ufachadta layla veyomam" – ze hallokeach tevua meerev shabbat leerev shabbat, "veal taamen bechayyecha" – ze hassomech al happalter.

a: Vehahu gavra al palter samech.
May have ala? amar rav yosef: rabbi yehuda moryayna deve nesia hava, veori leh kishmateh.

Ditnan, rabbi yehuda omer: shishsha devarim mikkulle bet shammay umechumere bet hillel. dam nevelot – bet shammay metaharin, uvet hillel metammein. amar rabbi yose berabbi yehuda: af keshettimmeu bet hillel, lo timmeu ella birviit, hoil veyachol likrosh velaamod al kezayit.
Mishna en mitnaddevin log, shenayim, vachamishsha, aval mitnaddevin shelosha, vearbaa, veshishsha, umishshishsha ulemala.
Gemara ibbaya lehu – yesh keva linsachim, o en keva linsachim?
Hechi dame? kegon deayyti chamsha. i amrat en keva linsachim – mashech umakrev arbea minnayyhu, dachaze leayil, veiddach have nedava. vei amrat yesh keva linsachim – ad dimmalle lehu la korvi.
May? amar abbaye: ta shema, shishsha lindava, veamrinan: keneged mi? keneged motar chattat, umotar ashamot, umotar asham nazir, umotar asham metzora, umotar kinnin, umotar minchat chote.
Veim ita, litakken shofar acharina keneged motar nesachim!
Hanach lenidvat tzibbur azli, hane shechichi, efshar demitztarfi demar udemar bahade hadade, vekarvi.
Amar rava: ta shema, "ezrach" – melammed shemmitnaddevin nesachim, vechamma? sheloshet luggin.
Uminnayin sheim ratza lehosif yosif? talmud lomar "yihye". yachol yifchot? talmud lomar "kacha".
May "yosif"? illema arbaa veshishsha – may shena shelosha? dachazu lecheves – arbaa veshishsha name chazu leayil ufar! ella lav, chamishsha, ushema minna en keva linsachim. shema minna.
Amar rav ashe: veha anan la tenan hachi? en mitnaddevin log shenayim vachamishsha. katane chamishsha dumeya dishnayim, ma shenayim dela chazu kelal, af chamishsha name dela chazu kelal.
Midde irya? ha kidita, veha kidita.
Amar abbaye: im timtza lomar en keva linsachim – ha en keva linsachim, im timtza lomar yesh keva linsachim – ad asara peshita li, achad asar
b: Mibbaya li, may: gavra lishne parim ka mechavven, vead dimmalle lehu la korvi, o dilma lishne elim vecheves echad kamchavvevyn? tere mechad mina vechad mechad mina amrinan, o la? may? teku.
Mishna mitnaddevin yayin, veen mitnaddevin shemen, divre rabbi akiva. rabbi tarfon omer: mitnaddevin shemen.

Amar rabbi tarfon: ma matzinu beyayin, shehu ba chova uva nedava, af shemen shehu ba chova ba nedava. amar lo rabbi akiva: lo, im amarta beyayin shekken karev im chovato bifne atzmo, tomar beshemen sheeno karev im chovato bifne atzmo?
En shenayim mitnaddevin issaron echad, aval mitnaddevin ola ushelamim, veof – afillu pereda achat.
Gemara amar rava: middivre shenehem nilmod, mitnaddev adam minchat nesachim bechol yom.
Peshita? mahu detema: minchat nedava galli ba rachamana – hane chamishsha menachot in, tefe la! ka mashma lan: hane mille bistama, aval hecha defaresh – paresh.
En shenayim mitnaddevin. may tama? illema mishshum dichtiv "takriv", ola name ha ketiv "yakriv"!
Ella ola may tama, dichtiv "leolotechem", mincha name ha ketiv "leminchotechem", ella mishshum dichtiv bah "nefesh".
Tanya name hachi, rabbi omer: "asher yakriv korbano lechol nidrehem ulechol nidvotam asher yakrivu laAdonai" – hakkol bain beshuttafut, lo sillek hakkatuv ella mincha, shenneemar: "nefesh".
Amar rabbi yitzchak: mippene ma nishtannet mincha shenneemar vah "nefesh"? amar hakkadosh baruch hu: mi darko lehavi mincha? ani, maale ani alav keillu hikriv nafsho lefanay.

Amar rabbi yitzchak: ma nishtannet mincha, (shenneemar) [shenneemru] bah chamishsha mine tiggun hallalu? mashal lemelech basar vedam sheasa lo ohavo seuda, veyodea bo shehu ani. amar lo: ase li min chamishsha mine tiggun, kede sheehane mimmecha.
Hadaran alach hammenachot vehannesachim.
Mishna "hare alay issaron" – yavi echad, "esronot" – yavi shenayim, "perashti veeni yodea ma perashti" – yavi shishshim issaron.
"Hare alay mincha" – yavi ezo sheyyirtze. rabbi yehuda omer: yavi minchat hassolet, shehi meyuchedet shebbammenachot.
"Mincha" o "min hammincha" – yavi achat. "menachot" o "min menachot" – yavi shetayim. "perashti veeni yodea eze mehen perashti" – yavi chamishtan.
Perashti mincha shel esronim, veeni yodea kamma perashti – yavi shishshim issaron. rabbi omer: yavi menachot shel esronot, meechad vead shishshim.
Gemara peshita! "esronot" – yavi shetayim itztericha leh. ha name peshita! miut esronot shetayim itztericha leh.
"Perashti, veeni yodea ma perashti" – yavi shishshim issaron. man tanna?
Amar chizkiyya: dela kerabbi, dei rabbi, haamar: yavi menachot shel esronot meechad vead shishshim.
Verabbi yochanan amar: afillu tema rabbi, beomer "perashti esronot aval lo kevatim bichli", demayyte shittin esronot beshittin mane.
"Hare alay mincha" – yavi ezehu sheyyirtze [vechulei]. tana: hoil ufatach bo hakkatuv techilla.
Ella meatta, haomer "hare alay ola" – yavi ben bakar, hoil ufatach bo hakkatuv

a: Techilla.
"Min hatztzon" – yavi keves, hoil ufatach bo hakkatuv techilla.
"Min haof" – yavi torim, hoil ufatach bo hakkatuv techilla.
Allema tenan: hare alay ola – yavi keves. rabbi elazar ben azarya omer: tor o ben yona, vela pelig rabbi yehuda.
Ella may meyuchedet shebbammenachot? delet leh shem levavy.
Veha tana hoil ufatach bo hakkatuv techilla kaamar? hachi kaamar: ezehu mincha meyuchedet shebbammenachot, delet leh shem levavy? zo sheppatach bo hakkatuv techilla.
Peshita, minchat hassolet kaamar, simana bealma.
"Mincha", "min hammincha" [vechulei]. bae rav pappa: "mine mincha" mahu?
Kevan deamar "mine", tarte kaamar, umay "mincha"? (dechulla) menachot name "mincha" mikkaryayn, dichtiv "vezot torat hammincha".
O dilma, kevan deamar "mincha", chada mincha kaamar, umay "mine mincha"? hachi kaamar: "mimmine mincha chada mincha alay".
Ta shema: "mincha" "min mincha" – yavi achat, ha "mine mincha" – shetayim.
Ema sefa: "menachot", "min menachot" – yavi shetayim, ha "mine mincha" – chada. ella, meha lekka lemishma minna.
Ta shema: "min menachot alay" – yavi shete menachot mimmin echad, ha "mimmine mincha" – chada.
Dilma: ha "mine mincha" – mevi shete menachot mishshene minin.
Veha la tane hachi, "min menachot alay" – mevi shete menachot mimmin echad, "mine menachot alay" – mevi shete menachot mishshene minin, ha "mine mincha" – chada.
Dilma ha manni, rabbi shimon hi, deamar: mechetza challot umechetza rekikin yavi, umay "mine mincha"? mincha deit ba tere mine.
Aval rabbanan deamri, mechetza challot umechetza rekikin – lo yavi, mevi shete menachot mishshene minin.
"Perashti veeni yodea ma perashti" – yavi chamishtan. man tanna?
Amar rabbi yirmeya: dela kerabbi shimon, dei rabbi shimon – kevan deamar mechetza challot umechetza rekikin yavi.
I name savar la kerabbi yehuda, deamar kol hammenachot baot eser, ikka lesappoka bearba esre menachot.
Abbaye amar: afillu tema rabbi shimon, shaminan leh lerabbi shimon deamar: mayyte umatne.
Detanya: rabbi shimon omer, lammochorat mevi ashamo veluggo
b: Immo, veomer: im metzora hu – zehu ashamo veze luggo, veim lav – asham ze yehe shalme nedava.
Veoto asham taun shechita batztzafon, umattan behonot, usemicha, unesachim, utenufat chaze vashok, veneechol lezichre chehunna leyom valayla.
Veaf al gav deka mefarek mar bishchitat kadashim.
Emar deamar rabbi shimon: mayyte umatne lechattechilla – letakkone gavra, aval bealma – diavad in, lechattechilla la.
Hane mille gabbe shelamim, deka memaet baachilatan, dehavu lehu kadashim levet happesul, aval menachot – afillu lechattechilla.
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: rabbi shimon deamar mechetza challot umechetza rekikin yavi, ha ka mayyte issaron echad mishshene issaron, velog echad mishshene luggin!
Shaminan leh lerabbi shimon, deamar: im hevi issaron echad mishshene esronot, velog echad mishshene luggin – yatza.

Umikmatz hechi kamatz? dematne veamar: i challot lechodayyhu, urekikin lechodayyhu amari – deka kametzna mechallot leheve achallot, deka kametzna merkikin leheve arkikin. i mechetza rekikin umechetza challot amari – deka kametzna mechallot leheve ammechetza challot umechetza rekikin, udeka kametzna merkikin lihvo ammechetza rekikin umechetza challot.
Veha bae mikmatz chad kometz mechallot

a: Umerkikin, veka kametz mechallot arkikin umerkikin achallot.
Shaminan leh lerabbi shimon, deamar: im kamatz veala beyado meechad al shenehem – yatza.
Veha ikka motar shemen, dei mechetza challot umechetza rekikin amar – motar hashshemen machziro lachallot, i kullehu rekikin amar – motar hashshemen neechol lakkohanim.
Kerabbi shimon ben yehuda, detanya: rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshum rabbi shimon: moshchan kemin ki, umotar hashshemen neechol lakkohanim.
Amar leh rav kahana lerav ashe: veha ikka lesappoka beminchat nesachim, deamar rava: mitnaddev adam minchat nesachim bechol yom.
Ki ka mistappeka leh (siman: "yachid", "biglal", "levona", "belog", "mekammetza") –
Baa biglal yachid, baa biglal tzibbur – la mistappeka leh.
Ki ka mistappeka leh – baa biglal atzmah, baa biglal zevach – la mistappeka leh.
Ki ka mistappeka leh – teuna levona, sheenah teuna levona – la mistappeka leh.
Ki ka mistappeka leh – baa belog, baa bishlosha luggin – la mistappeka leh.
Ki ka mistappeka leh – teuna kemitza, sheenah teuna kemitza – la ka mistappeka leh.
"Perashti mincha shel esronim".

Tanu rabbanan: "perashti mincha, vekavati bichli echad shel esronim, veeni yodea ma perashti" – yavi mincha shel shishshim esronim, divre chachamim. rabbi omer: yavi menachot shel esronim meechad vead shishshim, shehen elef ushemone meot usheloshim.

"Perashti veeni yodea ma perashti, vei zo mehen perashti, veeni yodea kamma perashti" – yavi chamesh menachot shel shishshim shishshim esronim, shehen shelosh meot, divre chachamim. rabbi omer: yavi chamesh menachot shel shishshim esronim meechad vead shishshim, shehen tisha alafim umea vachamishshim.
Bemay ka mippalgi? amar rav chisda: bemuttar lehachenis chullin laazara ka mippalgi, rabbi savar: asur lehachenis chullin laazara, verabbanan savri: muttar lehachenis chullin laazara.
Rava amar: dechulle alma asur lehachenis chullin laazara, vehacha bemuttar learev chova bindava ka mippalgi.
Rabbanan savri: muttar learev chova bindava, verabbi savar: asur learev chova bindava.
Amar leh abbaye lerava: lerabbanan deamri muttar learev chova bindava, ha baenan shene kematzim? dekametz vahadar kametz.
Veha ka kametz mechova annedava uminnedava achova!
Detale leh bedaat kohen, deamar: kol hecha dematya yeda dechohen hasheta – chova, ulevassof – nedava.
Veaktore hechi maktar? layktar nedava beresha – dechova hechi maktar la? dilma kulla chova hi, vechasru lehu shirayim.
Veamar mar: shirayim shechasru ben kemitza lehaketara – en maktir kometz alehen!
Layktar chova beresha – dindava hechi maktar la?
b: Vedilma kulla chova hi, vechol shehu mimmennu laishshim hare hu beval taktiru".
Amar rabbi yehuda bereh derabbi shimon ben pazzi: demassek lehu leshum etzim, ucherabbi eliezer. detanya, rabbi eliezer omer: lereach nichoach i atta maale, aval atta maale leshum etzim.

Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: vedilma dechulle alma muttar learev chova bindava, vehacha bidrabbi eliezer ka mippalgi – derabbanan it lehu derabbi eliezer, verabbi let leh derabbi eliezer?
Amar leh: i salka datach lerabbi muttar learev chova bindava, uderabbi eliezer let leh, efshar demayyte shittin bechad mana, vechad bechad mana, umagga lehu, vekametz.
Rava amar: dechulle alma muttar learev chova bindava, udechulle alma it lehu derabbi eliezer, vehacha biflugeta derabbi eliezer ben yaakov verabbanan ka mippalgi.
Ditnan: afillu mincha shel shishshim issaron noten lah shishshim log. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: afillu mincha shel shishshim issaron en lah ella luggah, shenneemar: "lemincha velog shamen".
Rabbanan savri [kerabbanan], deamri: shishshim log, vechol chad vechad issaron – lugga ka shakel.
Verabbi savar kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov, deamar en lah ella luggah, vela yadinan i chada mincha hi – desaggi la bechad log, i shete menachot ninhu – devaenan shene luggin.
Rav ashe amar: bekatan vehevi gadol kamippalgi. rabbanan savri: katan vehevi gadol – yatza, verabbi savar: lo yatza.
Veha ippeligu ba chada zimna, ditnan: katan vehevi gadol – yatza, rabbi omer: lo yatza.
Tzericha, dei ittemar beha – beha ka amri rabbanan, mishshum deidde veidde kometz hu; aval hatam, deka nefishi emurin – ema modu leh lerabbi.
Vei ittemar behahi – behahi kaamar rabbi, aval beha ema mode lehu lerabbanan; tzericha.
Siman: etzim, zahav, yayin, ola, toda, shor.
Mishna hare alay etzim – lo yifchot mishshene gezirin, levona – lo yifchot mikkometz.
Chamishsha kematzim hem: haomer "alay levona" – lo yifchot mikkometz, hamenaddev mincha – yavi immah kometz levona, hammaale et hakkometz bachutz – chayyayv, shene bazichin teunin shene kematzim.

"Hare alay zahav" – lo yifchot middinar zahav, "kesef" – lo yifchot middinar kesef, "nechoshet" – lo yifchot mimmaa kesef. "perashti veeni yodea ma perashti" – yehe mevi ad sheyyomar "lo lechach nitkavvavnti".

Gemara tanu rabbanan: "korban" – melammed shemmitnaddevin etzim, vechamma? shene gezirin. vechen hu omer: "vehaggoralot hippalnu al kurban haetzim". rabbi omer: etzim korban hem, teunin melach uteunin haggasha.
Amar rava: uledivre rabbi, etzim teunin kemitza. amar rav pappa: ledivre rabbi, etzim tzerichin etzim.

Levona – lo yifchot min hakkometz. menalan? dichtiv: "veherim mimmennu bekumtzo missolet hammincha umishshamnah veet kol hallevona". makkish levona laharama demincha – ma harama demincha kometz, af levona name kometz.
Tanu rabbanan: "hare alay lammizbeach" – yavi levona, sheen lecha davar shekkarev legabbe mizbeach ella levona. "perashti veeni yodea ma perashti" – yavi mikkol davar shekkarev lammizbeach.
Vetu lekka? veha ikka ola! ikka orah lechohanim.
Veha ikka olat haof, ikka

a: Murea venotza.
Vehaikka nesachim, lashshitin azli.
Vehaikka minchat nesachim? kevan deikka mincha deachli kohanim minna, la pesika leh.
"Hare alay zahav" – lo yifchot middinar zahav. vedilma nesacha? amar rabbi elazar: deamar "matbea". vedilma perite? amar rav pappa: perite dedahava la avdi inashe.
"Kesef" – lo yifchot middinar. vedilma nesacha? amar rabbi elazar: deamar "matbea", vedilma perite? amar rav sheshet: beatra dela sagu perite dechaspa.

"Nechoshet" – lo yifchot mimmaa kesef. tanya: rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer – lo yifchot mitztzinnora ketanna shel nechoshet. lemay chazya? amar abbaye: shemmechattetin bah petilot, umekannechin bah nerot.
Barzel, tanya, acherim omrim: lo yifchot mikkalya orev, vechamma? amar rav yosef: amma al amma.
Ikka deamri: lo yifchot meamma al amma. lemay chazya? amar rav yosef: lechalya orev.
Mishna "hare alay yayin" – lo yifchot mishshelosha luggin, "shemen" – lo yifchot millog, rabbi omer: shelosha luggin.
"Perashti, veeni yodea ma perashti" – yavi keyom merubbe.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: "ezrach" – melammed shemmitnaddevin yayin, vechamma? shelosha luggin.
Uminnayin sheim ratza lehosif yosif? talmud lomar "yihye". yachol yifchot? talmud lomar "kacha".
Shemen – lo yifchot min hallog, rabbi omer: shelosha luggin. bemay ka mippalgi?
Amruha rabbanan kammeh derav pappa: bedun minna uminna, bedun minna veokem beatra – ka mippalgi.
Rabbanan savri: dun minna uminna, ma mincha mitnaddevin – af shemen name mitnaddevin, uminna: ma mincha belog – af shemen belog.
Verabbi savar: dun minna veoke beatra, ma mincha mitnaddevin, af shemen name mitnaddevin, veoke beatra kinsachim, ma nesachim sheloshet luggin, af shemen name sheloshet luggin.
Amar lehu rav pappa: i mimmincha gamar la rabbi, dechulle alma la peligi dun minna uminna, ella rabbi meezrach" gemir la.

Amar leh rav huna bereh derav natan lerav pappa: umi matzet amrat hachi? vehatanya: "korban" – melammed shemmitnaddevin shemen, vechamma? sheloshet luggin. man shamat leh deamar sheloshet luggin? rabbi, veka mayyte la mikkorban". amar leh: i tanya tanya.
"Perashti, veeni yodea ma perashti" – yavi keyom merubbe. tena: keyom tov harishon shel chag shechal lihyot bashshabbat.
Mishna "hare alay ola" – yavi keves. rabbi elazar ben azarya omer: o tor o ben yona.
"Perashti min habbakar, veeni yodea ma perashti" – yavi par veegel. "min habbehema, veeni yodea ma perashti" – yavi par veegel, ayil, sair, gedi vetale. "perashti, veeni yodea ma perashti" –
b: Mosif alehen tor uven yona.

"Hare alay toda ushelamim" – yavi keves. "perashti min bakar, veeni yodea ma perashti" – yavi par ufara, egel veegla. "min habbehema, veeni yodea ma perashti" – yavi par ufara, egel veegla, ayil urechela, sair useira, gedi ugediyyay, tale vetalyay.
"Hare alay shor" – yavi hu unesachav bemane, "egel" – yavi hu unesachav bechamesh, "ayil" – yavi hu unesachav bishtayim, "keves" – yavi hu unesachav besela.

"Shor bemane" – yavi bemane, chutz minnesachav. "egel bechamesh" – yavi bechamesh, chutz minnesachav. "ayil bishtayim" – yavi bishtayim, chutz minnesachav. "keves besela" – yavi bassela, chutz minnesachav.
"Shor bemane", vehevi shenayim bemane – lo yatza, vaafillu ze bemane chaser dinar veze bemane chaser dinar.
"Shachor" vehevi lavan, "lavan" vehevi shachor, "gadol" vehevi katan – lo yatza. "katan" vehevi gadol – yatza. rabbi omer: lo yatza.
Gemara vela peligi, mar ki atreh umar ki atreh.

Tanu rabbanan: "hare alay ola besela lammizbeach" – yavi keves, sheen lecha davar shekkarev besela legabbe mizbeach ella keves. "shekkarev besela perashti, veeni yodea ma perashti" – yavi mikkol davar shekkarev besela legabbe mizbeach.
"Perashti min habbakar, veeni yodea ma perashti" – yavi par veegel. ammay? velayte par, mimma nafshach!
Ha manni? rabbi hi, deamar: katan vehevi gadol – lo yatza.
I rabbi, ema sefa: "shor bemane" vehevi shenayim bemane – lo yatza, vaafillu ze bemane chaser dinar veze bemane chaser dinar.
"Shachor" vehevi lavan, "lavan" vehevi shachor, "gadol" vehevi katan – lo yatza, "katan" vehevi gadol – yatza, rabbi omer: lo yatza.
Resha vesefa – rabbi, umetziata – rabbanan.
In, resha vesefa rabbi, metziata rabbanan, vehachi kaamar: davar ze machloket rabbi verabbanan.
Tenan hatam: shishsha lindava, keneged mi? (siman (220) [157] 370.)
Amar chizkiyya: keneged shishsha batte avot hakkohanim, shettikkenu lahem chachamim sheyyehe shalom ze im ze.
Rabbi yochanan amar: mittoch shehannedava merubba, tikkenu lahem shofarot merubbin, kede shello yitappeshu hammaot.
Uzeeri amar: keneged par vaegel, ayil vacheves, gedi vesair, verabbi hi, deamar: katan vehevi gadol – lo yatza.
Uvar peda amar: keneged happarim, vehaelim,

a: Vehakkevasim, vehasseirim, vehammotarot, vehammaa.
Kullehu kechizkiyya la amri, leinnetzoye la chayyshinan, dechol chad vechad yomeh ka aved.
Kerabbi yochanan la amri, leiapposhe la chayyshinan.
Kizeri la amri, kichidaa la mokmi.
Kevar peda name la amri. motarot – kullehu name motarot.
Maa name lishkalim azla, detanya: lehechan kalbon ze holech? lishkalim, divre rabbi meir. rabbi eliezer omer: lindava.
Ushemuel amar: keneged motar chattat, umotar asham, umotar asham nazir, umotar asham metzora, umotar minchat chote, umotar asirit haefa shel kohen gadol.
Verabbi oshaya amar: keneged motar chattat, umotar asham, umotar asham nazir, umotar asham metzora, umotar kinnin, umotar minchat chote.
Ushemuel may tama la amar kerabbi oshaya? kinnin tena leh resha.
Verabbi oshaya tane, vela tane kinnin? vehatane rabbi oshaya vetane kinnin! chad lekinnin, vechad lemotar kinnin.
Verabbi oshaya may tama la amar kishmuel? savar la keman deamar: motar shel asirit haefa shel kohen gadol yirkav, detanya: motar minchat – nedava, motar mincha – yirkav.
May kaamar? amar rav chisda: hachi kaamar – motar minchat chote nedava, motar asirit haefa shel kohen gadol – yirkav.
Rabba amar: afillu motar asirit haefa shel kohen gadol – name nedava, ella motar lachme toda – yirkav.
Biflugeta: motar asirit haefa shel kohen gadol, rabbi yochanan amar: nedava, rabbi elazar amar: yirkav.
Metivi: motar shekalim – chullin, umotar asirit haefa, umotar kinne zavin vekinne zavot vekinne yoldot vechattaot vaashamot – motrehen nedava.
May lav: motar asirit haefa – shel kohen gadol?
Lo, motar minchat chote.
Amar rav nachman bar rav yitzchak: mistabbera keman deamar motar asirit haefa shel kohen gadol yirkav.

Detanya: "lo yasim aleha shemen velo yitten aleha levona ki chattat hi", amar rabbi yehuda: hi keruya "chattat", veen acheret keruya "chattat". limmed al asirit haefa shel kohen gadol sheenah keruya "chattat", uteuna levona.
Umiddeenah keruya "chattat", motarah yirkav.
Mishna "shor ze ola", venistaev – im ratza yavi bedamav shenayim. "shene shevavrim ellu ola", venistaavu – ratza yavi bidmehen echad, verabbi oser.
"Ayil ze ola", venistaev – im ratza yavi bedamav keves. "keves ze ola", venistaev – im ratza yavi bedamav ayil, verabbi oser.
b: Gemara veha amrat resha: "shor bemane" vehevi shenayim bemane – lo yatza.
"Shor ze" venistaev shane.
"Shene shevavrin ellu ola" venistaavu, ratza yavi bidmehen echad, verabbi oser. may tama?
Mishshum dehave leh gadol vehevi katan, veaf al gav denistaev, lechitchilla la share rabbi.
Veliflog name beresha?
Rabbi akkulla milleta pelig, venatar lehu lerabbanan ad demasseki milletayyhu, vahadar mippelig alayyhu.
Teda, dekatane: "ayil ze ola" venistaev – ratza yavi bedamav keves; "keves ze leola" venistaev – ratza yavi bedamav ayil, verabbi oser. shema minna.
Ibbaya lehu: mimmina lemina may?
Ta shema: shor ze ola, venistaev – lo yavi bedamav ayil, aval mevi bedamav shene elim, verabbi oser, lefi sheen billa. shema minna.
I hachi, may irya tere? afillu chad name! deha benistaev, lerabbanan la shane lehu ben gadol lekatan!
Tere tannae, veallibba derabbanan.
Rabbi oser, lefi sheen billa; tama deen billa, ha yesh billa – shere.
Vehatnan: "ayil ze ola" venistaev, ratza yavi bedamav keves. "keves ze ola" venistaev, yavi bedamav ayil, verabbi oser.
Tere tannae, veallibba derabbi.
Uvithorim, "egel" vehevi par, "keves" vehevi ayil – yatza. setama – kerabbanan.
Ratza yavi bedamav shenayim [kulei]. amar rav menashsheya bar zevid amar rav: lo shanu ella deamar "shor ze ola", aval amar "shor ze alay ola" – hukeba.
Vedilma "alay lahavio" kaamar?
Ella i ittemar hachi ittemar, amar rav menashsheya bar zevid amar rav: lo shanu ella deamar "shor ze ola", i name amar "shor ze alay ola", aval amar "shor ze vedamav alay ola" – hukeba.

Mishna haomer "echad mikkevasay hekdesh" veechad mishshevaray hekdesh", vehayu lo shenayim – haggadol shebbahen hekdesh. shelosha – benoni shebbahem hekdesh. "perashti, veeni yodea ma shepperashti", o sheamar li abba, veeni yodea ma" – haggadol shebbahen hekdesh.
Gemara alma makdish – beayin yafa makdish, ema sefa: benoni shebbahen hekdesh, alma makdish – beayin raa makdish!
Amar shemuel: choshshin af levenoni, dilgabbe katan – ayin yafa hu.
Hechi aved? amar rabbi chiyyay bar rav: mamtin lo ad sheyyumam, umachel leh likdushsheteh baggadol.
Amar rav nachman, amar rabba bar avu: lo shanu ella deamar "echad mishshevavray hekdesh", aval amar "shor bishvavray hekdesh" – haggadol shebbahen hekdesh, "tora betoray" kaamar.
Ini? vehaamar rav huna, amar rabbi chiyyay mishshemeh deulla: haomer lachavero "bayit bevattay ani mocher lach" – marehu aliyyay, lav mishshum digria? la, meulle shebbabbattim.
Metivi: "shor bishvavray hekdesh", vechen shor shel hekdesh shennitarev baacherim – haggadol shebbahen hekdesh, vechullam yimmachru letzorche olot, udemehen chullin.
Targuma: ashshor shel hekdesh shennitarev baacherim. veha "vechen" kaamar? targevma: aggadol.
Metivi: "bayit bevaytay ani mocher lach", venafal – marehu naful, "eved baavadayy ani mocher lach", vamet – marehu met.

a: Veammay? lichze heyden nefal, heyden met!
Lokeach ka amrat? shane lokeach, deyad baal hashshetar al hattachtona.
Hasheta deatet lehachi, afillu tema aliyyay digria – yad baal hashshetar al hattachtona.

Mishna "hare alay ola" – yakrivenna bammikdash, veim hikrivah bevet chonyo – lo yatza. "hare alay ola sheakrivenna bevet chonyo" – yakrivenna bammikdash, veim hikrivah bevet chonyo – yatza. rabbi shimon omer: en zo ola.

"Hareni nazir" – yegallach bammikdash, veim gillach bevet chonyo – lo yatza. "hareni nazir sheagalleach bevet chonyo" – yegalleach bammikdash, veim gillach bevet chonyo – yatza. rabbi shimon omer: en ze nazir.
Gemara yatza? ha miktal katla!
Amar rav hamenuna: naasa keomer "hare alay ola, al menat shello etchayyev beachrayutah".

Amar leh rava: ella meatta, sefa dekatane hareni nazir sheagalleach bevet chonyo – yegallach bammikdash, veim gillach bevet chonyo – yatza, hachi name denaasa keomer "hareni nazir al menat shello etchayyev beachrayut korbenotav"? nazir kamma dela mayyte korbenotav – la mittachshar!
Ella amar rava: adam ze ledoron nitkavven, amar: i saggi bevet chonyo – tarachna, tefe – la matzena leitztaore.
Nazir name, hay gavra letzaore nafsheh ka mikkavven, amar: i saggi bevet chonyo – tarachna, tefe la matzena leitztaore.
Verav hamenuna amar lach: nazir – kidkaamrat, ola – al menat shello etchayyev beachrayutah kaamar.
Veaf rabbi yochanan savar la leha derav hamenuna, deamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: "hare alay ola sheakrivenna bevet chonyo", vehikrivah beeretz yisrael – yatza, veanush karet.
Tanya name hachi: hare alay ola sheakrivenna bammidbar, vehikrivah beever hayyarden – yatza, veanush karet.

Mishna hakkohanim sheshshimmeshu bevet chonyo – lo yeshammeshu bammikdash shebbirushalayim, veen tzarich lomar ledavar acher, shenneemar: "ach lo yaalu kohane habbamot el mizbach Adonai birushalim ki im achlu matztzot bekerev achehem". hare ellu kevaale mumin – cholkin veochlin velo makrivin.
Gemara amar rav yehuda: kohen sheshshachat laavoda zara, korbano reach nichoach.

Amar rav yitzchak bar avdimi: may keraa? "yaan asher yeshartu otam lifne gillulehem vehayu levet yisrael lemichshol avon al ken nasati yadi alehem neum Adonai elohim venasu avonam", uchetiv batreh: "velo yiggeshu elay lechahen li". i avad sherut – in, shechita lav sherut hu.
Ittemar: shagag bizrika, rav nachman amar: korbano reach nichoach, rav sheshet amar: en korbano reach nichoach.
Amar rav sheshet: mena amena la, dichtiv: "vehayu levet yisrael lemichshol avon", may lav – o michshol o avon, umichshol" – shogeg, veavon" – mezid.
Verav nachman – "michshol" deavon".
Amar rav nachman: mena amena la, detanya: "vechipper hakkohen al hannefesh hashshogeget becheta vishgaga", melammed shekkohen mitkapper al yede atzmo.
Bemay? ilema bishchita – may irya shogeg? afillu mezid name! ella lav bizrika.
Verav sheshet amar lach: leolam bishchita, uvemezid – lo naasa komer laavoda zara?!
Veazdu letamayyhu, deittemar: hezid bishchita – rav nachman amar: korbano reach nichoach, verav sheshet amar: en korbano reach nichoach.
Rav nachman amar: korbano reach nichoach, dela avad sherut. rav sheshet amar: en korbano reach nichoach,
b: Naasa komer laavoda zara.
Amar rav nachman: mena amena la? detanya: kohen sheavad avoda zara, veshav, korbano reach nichoach.
Bemay? illema beshogeg – may "veshav"? shav veomed hu! ella peshita bemezid, vei bizrika – ki shav may have? ha avad le sherut! ella lav bishchita.
Verav sheshet amar lach, leolam beshogeg, vehachi kaamar: im shav meikkaro, dechi avad beshogeg avad – korbano reach nichoach, veim lav – en korbano reach nichoach.

Hishtachava laavoda zara – rav nachman amar: korbano reach nichoach, verav sheshet amar: en korbano reach nichoach. hoda laavoda zara – rav nachman amar: korbano reach nichoach, verav sheshet amar: en korbano reach nichoach.
Utzericha, dei ashmeinan hach kammayyta – behahi kaamar rav sheshet mishshum daavad leh sherut, aval shechita dela avad leh sherut – ema mode leh lerav nachman.
Vei ashmeinan shechita, mishshum deaved leh avoda, aval hishtachava dela avad leh avoda – ema la. tzericha.
Vei ashmeinan hishtachavaa, mishshum deaved leh maase, aval hoda dedibbura bealma – ema la. tzericha.
Veen tzarich lomar davar acher [vechulei]. middekaamar: en tzarich lomar davar acher, mikkelal devet chonyo lav avoda zara hu.
Tanya keman deamar bet chonyo lav avoda zara hu, detanya: otah shana shemmet shimon hatztzaddik, amar lahen: shana zo hu met, amru lo: minnayin atta yodea?

Amar lahen: kol yom hakkippurim nizdammen li zaken echad lavush levanim, venitattef levanim, venichnas immi veyatza immi. shana zo nizdammen li zaken echad lavush shechorim, venitattef shechorim, venichnas immi velo yatza immi.
Leachar haregel, chala shivat yamim vamet, venimneu echav hakkohanim millevarech bashshem.

Bishat petirato, amar lahem: chonyo beni yeshammesh tachtay. nitkanne bo shimi achiv, shehaya gadol mimmennu shete shanim umechetza. amar lo: bo vaalammedcha seder avoda. hilbisho beunekli, vachagaro betziltzol, (heemidu) [veheemido] etzel hammizbeach. amar lahem leechav hakkohanim: reu ma nadar ze vekiyyem laahuvato: "oto hayyom sheeshtammesh bichhunna gedola elbosh beunekli shellichi veechgor betziltzol shellichi".

Bikkeshu echav hakkohanim lehorgo, ratz mippenehem, veratzu acharav. halach laalekkesanderiyya shel mitzrayim, uvana sham mizbeach, veheela alav leshum avoda zara. uchesheshshamu chachamim baddavar, amru: ma ze shello yarad lah – kach, hayyored lah – al achat kamma vechamma. divre rabbi meir.

Amar lo rabbi yehuda: lo kach haya maase, ella lo kibbel alav chonyo, shehaya shimi achiv gadol mimmennu shete shanim umechetza, veaf al pi chen nitkanne bo chonyo beshimi achiv. amar lo: bo vaalammedcha seder avoda, vehilbisho beunekli, vachagaro betziltzol, veheemido etzel hammizbeach. amar lahem leechav hakkohanim: reu ma nadar ze vekiyyem laahuvato "oto hayyom sheyyishtammesh bichhunna gedola elbosh beunekli shellichi veechgor betziltzol shellichi".

Bikkeshu echav hakkohanim lehorgo, sach lahem kol hameora, bikkeshu laharog et chonyo, ratz mippenehem, veratzu acharav, ratz levet hammelech, veratzu acharav, kol haroe oto omer: ze hu, ze hu, halach laalekkesanderiyya shel mitzrayim, uvana sham mizbeach, veheela alav leshem shamayim, shenneemar: "(vehaya) bayyom hahu yihye mizbeach laAdonai betoch eretz mitzrayim umatztzeva etzel gevulah laAdonai".
Uchesheshshamu chachamim baddavar, amru: uma ze shebbarach mimmenna kach, hamevakkesh lered lah – al achat kamma vechamma.
Tanya, amar rabbi yehoshua ben perachya: battechilla, kol haomer "ale lah" – ani kofto venotno lifne haari; atta, kol haomer li lered mimmenna – ani metil alav kumekum shel chammin.
Shehare shaul barach mimmenna, uchesheala bikkesh laharog et david.
Amar leh mar kashshisha bereh derav chisda leabbaye: rabbi meir, hay kera derabbi yehuda may aved leh?

Lechidtanya: leachar mappalto shel sancheriv, yatza chizkiyya umatza bene melachim shehayu yoshvin bikronot shel zahav, hiddiran shello laavod avoda zara, shenneemar: "bayyom hahu yihyu chamesh arim beeretz mitzrayim medabberot sefat kenaan

a: Venishbaot laAdonai tzevaot". halchu laalekkesanderiyya shel mitzrayim uvanu mizbeach veheelu alav leshem shamayim, shenneemar: "bayyom hahu yihye mizbeach laAdonai betoch eretz mitzrayim".

"Ir haheres yeamer leachat", may "ir haheres yeamer leechat"? kedimtargem rav yosef: "karta devet shemesh daatid lemicharav", itamar dehi chada minnehon. umimmay deir haheres" lishshana deshimsha hi? dichtiv: "haomer lacheres velo yizrach".

"Havii vanay merachok uvenotay miktze haaretz" – "havii vanay merachok", amar rav huna: ellu galiyyot shel bavel, sheddatan meyushshevet alehen kevanim. "uvenotay miktze haaretz" – ellu galiyyot shel shear aratzot, sheen datan meyushshevet alehen kevanot.

Amar rabbi abba bar rav yitzchak, amar rav chisda, veamri la amar rav yehuda, amar rav: mitztzor vead kartigne makkirin et yisrael veet avihem shebbashshamayim, umitztzor kelappe maarav umikkartigne kelappe mizrach en makkirin et yisrael velo et avihen shebbashshamayim.
Etiveh rav shimi bar chiyyay lerav: "mimmizrach shemesh vead mevoo gadol shemi baggoyim uvechol makom muktar muggash lishmi umincha tehora". amar leh: shimi at?! dekaru leh elaha delaha.

"Bechol makom muktar muggash lishmi" – bechol makom salka datach? amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: ellu talmide chachamim haoskim battora bechol makom, maale ani alehen keillu maktirin umaggishin lishmi.
"Umincha tehora" – ze hallomed tora betohora, nose ishsha veachar kach lomed tora.

"Shir hammaalot hinne barchu et Adonai kol avde Adonai haomdim bevet Adonai ballelot", may "ballelot"? amar rabbi yochanan: ellu talmide chachamim haoskim betora ballayla, maale alehen hakkatuv keillu asukim baavoda.
"Leolam zot al yisrael", amar rav giddel amar rav: ze mizbeach banuy, umichael sar haggadol omed umakriv alav korban.
Verabbi yochanan amar: ellu talmide chachamim haasukin behilchot avoda, maale alehem hakkatuv keillu nivna mikdash bimehem.
Amar resh lakish: may dichtiv "zot hattora laola lammincha velachattat velaasham" – kol haosek battora keillu hikriv ola, mincha, chattat, veasham.
Amar rava: hay "laola lammincha" – "ola umincha" mibbee leh! ella amar rava: kol haosek battora eno tzarich lo ola (velo chattat) velo mincha velo asham.
Amar rabbi yitzchak: may dichtiv "zot torat hachattat" vezot torat haasham"? kol haosek betorat chattat – keillu hikriv chattat, vechol haosek betorat asham – keillu hikriv asham.

Mishna neemar beolat behema "ishshe reach nichoach", uveolat of "ishshe reach nichoach", uvemincha "ishshe reach nichoach", lomar lecha: echad hammarbe veechad hammamit, uvilvad sheyyechavven libbo lashshamayim.
Gemara amar rabbi zera: may keraa? "metuka shenat haoved im meat veim harebe yochel".
Rav adda bar ahava amar, mehacha: "birvot hattova rabbu ochleha uma kishron livalav".
Tanya, amar rabbi shimon ben azzay: bo uree ma ketiv befarashat korbanot, shello neemar bahen lo "el" velo "elohim", ella "Adonai", shello litten pitchon pe levaal din lachlok.

Veneemar beshor haggas "ishshe reach nichoach", uveof haddak "ishshe reach nichoach", uvemincha "ishshe reach nichoach", lomar lecha: echad hammarbe veechad hammamit, uvilvad sheyyechavven et libbo lashshamayim.

Veshemma tomar: laachila hu tzarich, talmud lomar: "im erav lo omar lach ki li tevel umeloah", veneemar: "ki li chol chayto yaar behemot beharere alef, yadati kol of harim veziz saday immadi", "haochal besar abbirim vedam attudim eshte".
Lo amarti alechem zivchu, kede shettomar "eese retzono veyaase retzoni". lo lirtzoni attem zovchim, ella lirtzonchem attem zovchim, shenneemar: "lirtzonchem tizbachuhu".
Davar acher: "lirtzonchem tizbachuhu" – lirtzonchem zivchu, ledatechem zivchu.
Kediva minneh shemuel merav huna: minnayin lammitassek bakkodashim shehu pasul? shenneemar: "veshachat et ben habbakar", shettehe shechita leshem ben bakar.
Amar lo: zo beyadenu hu, leakkev minnayin? talmud lomar: "lirtzonchem tizbachuhu" – ledatechem zivchu.
Hadaran alach hare alay issaron, uselika la massechet menachot.
Mishna hakkol shochatin ushechitatan keshera, chutz mecheresh shote vekatan, shemma yekalkelu et shechitatan. vechullan sheshshachatu vaacherim roin otan – shechitatan keshera.
Gemara "hakkol shochatin" – lechattechilla, "ushechitatan keshera" – diavad!

Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: vechol "hakkol" lechattechilla hu? ella meatta: hakkol memirin, echad haanashim veechad hannashim – hachi name dilchattechilla hu? veha ketiv: "lo yachalifennu velo yamir oto tov bera o ra betov"!
Hatam, kidkatane tama: lo shehaadam rashshay lehamir, ella sheim hemir – mumar, vesofeg et haarbaim.
Ella hakkol maarichin veneerachin, nodrin veniddarin, hachi name dilchattechilla? veha ketiv: "vechi techdal lindor lo yihye vecha chet"!

Uchetiv: "tov asher lo tiddor mishshettiddor velo teshallem", vetanya: tov mizze umizze sheeno noder kol ikkar, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: tov mizze umizze noder umeshallem. vaafillu rabbi yehuda la kaamar ella beomer "hare zo",
b: Aval amar "hare alay" – lo.
Vechol "hakkol" lav lechattechilla hu? ella "hakkol chayyayvim besukka", "hakkol chayyayvin betzitzit", hachi name delav lechattechilla?
Chayyayvin – la kaamena. ella meatta, "hakkol somchin, echad haanashim veechad hannashim" – hachi name delav lechattechilla? veha ketiv: "vesamach yado … venirtza"!
In, ikka "hakkol" lechattechilla, veikka "hakkol" diavad. ella "hakkol" dehacha, mimmay dilchattechilla hu detikshe lach? dilma diavad hu, vela tikshe lach.
Amar leh: ana "shechitatan keshera" kashya li, middekatane shechitatan keshera diavad, mikkelal dehakkol" lechattechilla hu, dei diavad – tarte diavad lema li?

Amar rabba bar ulla: hachi katane – hakkol shochatin, vaafillu tame bechullin. tame bechullin may lememra? bechullin shennaasu al tohorat hakkodesh, vekasavar: chullin shennaasu al tohorat hakkodesh kekodesh damu.
Ketzad hu ose? mevi sakkin arukka veshochet bah, kede shello yigga babbasar.
Uvemukedashim lo yishchot, shemma yigga babbasar, veim shachat veomer "bari li shello nagati" – shechitato keshera.
Chutz mecheresh shote vekatan, daafillu bechullin gerede, diavad name la, shemma yishhu, shemma yidresu, veshemma yachalidu.
Vechullan sheshshachatu, aheyay? illema acheresh shote vekatan – ala kae, "veim shachatu" mibbee leh! ella attame bechullin – ha amrat: lechattechilla name shachet!
Veella, attame bemukedashim – bevari li" saggi! deleteh kamman dinshayyeyleh.

Hay tame bemukedashim, mehacha nafka? mehatam nafka: kol happesulin sheshshachatu – shechitatan keshera, shehashshechita keshera bezarim, benashim, uvaavadim, uvitmeim, vaafillu bekodshe kadashim, uvilvad shello yihyu temein nogin babbasar.
Hacha ikkar. hatam, ayyeyde ditna shear pesulin – tena name tame bemukedashim. veibbaet ema: hatam ikkar, divkadashim kae. hacha, ayyeyde ditna tame bechullin – tane name tame bemukedashim.
Hay tame, deittamma bemay? illema deittammi bemet, "bachalal cherev" amar rachamana,

a: Cherev hare hu kechalal, av hattumea hu, letammeyeh lesakkin, vaazal sakkin vetammiteh levasar!
Ella deittammi besheretz, vei baet ema: leolam deittammi bemet, uchegon shebbadak kerumit shel kane veshachat bah, detanya: bakkol shochatim, ben betzor ben bizchuchit ben bikrumit shel kane.
Abbaye amar: hachi katane – hakkol shochatin, vaafillu kuti. bamme devarim amurim? kesheyyisrael omed al gabbav, aval yotze venichnas – lo yishchot.
Veim shachat, chotech kezayit basar venoten lo. achalo – muttar leechol mishshechitato, lo achalo – asur leechol mishshechitato.
Chutz mecheresh shote vekatan, daafillu diavad name la, shemma yishhu, shemma yidresu, veshemma yachalidu.
Vechullan sheshshachatu, aheyay? illema acheresh shote vekatan – ala kae, "veim shachatu" mibbee leh!
Ella, akkuti – ha amrat: kesheyyisrael omed al gabbav shachet afillu lechattechilla! kashya.
Amar rava: veyotze venichnas, lechattechilla la? vehatnan: hammanniach nachri bachanuto veyisrael yotze venichnas – muttar! hatam mi katane "manniach"? "hammanniach" katane, diavad.
Ella mehacha: en hashshomer tzarich lihyot yoshev umeshammer, ella af al pi sheyyotze venichnas – muttar.

Ella amar rava, hachi katane: hakkol shochatin, vaafillu kuti. bamme devarim amurim? kesheyyisrael yotze venichnas, aval ba umetzao sheshshachat – chotech kazzayit basar venoten lo, achalo – muttar leechol mishshechitato, lo achalo – asur leechol mishshechitato.

Chutz mecheresh shote vekatan, daafillu diavad name la, shemma yishhu, veshemma yidresu, veshemma yachalidu. vechullan sheshshachatu – aheyay? illema acheresh shote vekatan – ala kae, "veim shachatu" mibbee leh!
Ella akkuti? ha amrat: afillu yotze venichnas shachet lechattechilla! kashya.
Rav ashe amar: hachi katane – hakkol shochatin, vaafillu yisrael meshummad. meshummad lemay? leechol nevelot leteavon, vechidrava, deamar rava: yisrael meshummad ochel nevelot leteavon
b: Bodek sakkin venoten lo, umuttar leechol mishshechitato. aval lo badak venatan lo – lo yishchot, veim shachat – bodek sakkino acharav. nimtzet sakkino yafa – muttar leechol mishshechitato, veim lav – asur leechol mishshechitato.

Chutz mecheresh shote vekatan, daafillu diavad name la, shemma yishhu, shemma yidresu, veshemma yachalidu. vechullan sheshshachatu – aheyay? illema acheresh shote vekatan – ala kae, "veim shachatu" mibbee leh!

Ella ayyisrael meshummad? i devadak sakkin venoten lo, ha amrat shochet lechattechilla! ella delo badak. i deiteh lesakkin – livdekeh hasheta, vei deleteh lesakkin – ki acherim roin oto may have? dilma besakkin peguma shachet! kashya.
Ravina amar: hachi katane – "hakkol shochatin", hakkol mumechin shochatin, mumechin veaf al pi sheen muchezakin.

Bamme devarim amurim? sheyyodin bo sheyyodea lomar hilchot shechita, aval en yodin bo sheyyodea lomar hilchot shechita – lo yishchot, veim shachat – bodkin oto, im yodea lomar hilchot shechita – muttar leechol mishshechitato, veim lav – asur leechol mishshechitato.

Chutz mecheresh shote vekatan, daafillu diavad name la, shemma yishhu, shemma yidresu, veshemma yachalidu. vechullan sheshshachatu – aheyay? illema acheresh shote vekatan ala kae, veim shachatu mibbee leh!
Ella, ashsheen mumechin, bevodkin oto saggi! deleteh lekamman delivdekeh.

Veikka deamri, ravina amar: hachi katane – "hakkol shochatin", hakkol muchezakin shochatin, muchezakin af al pi sheen mumechin. bamme devarim amurim? sheshshachatu lefanenu shetayim veshalosh peamim velo nitallef, aval lo shachat lefanenu shetayim veshalosh peamim – lo yishchot, shemma yitallef. veim shachat veamar: "bari li shello nitallafti" – shechitato keshera.

Chutz mecheresh shote vekatan, daafillu diavad name la, shemma yishhu, shemma yidresu, veshemma yachalidu. vechullan sheshshachatu – aheyay? illema acheresh shote vekatan ala kae, "veim shachatu" mibbee leh!
Ella, ashsheen muchezakin, vehaamrat: bevari li" saggi! deleteh kamman delishayyeyleh.
Ravina verabba bar ulla, keabbayye verava verav ashe la amri, mishshum dekashya lehu "vechullan".
Kullehu kerabba bar ulla la amri, lehach lishshana deamrat hacha ikkar – adderabba, hatam ikkar, divkadashim kae.

Lehach lishshana deamrat: hatam ikkar, vehacha ayyeyde ditna tame bechullin tena name tame bemukedashin – tame bechullin gufeh la itztericha leh, chullin shennaasu al tohorat kodesh lav kekodesh damu.
Kullehu keravina la amri, lehach lishshana deamar: mumechin in, sheen mumechin la – rov metzuyin etzel shechita mumechin hen.
Lehach lishshana deamar: muchezakin in, sheen muchezakin la – leillofe la chayyshinan.
Rava la amar keabbayye, ki kusheyeh. abbaye la amar kerava, hatam la naga, hacha naga.
Rav ashe la amar ketarvayyhu, kasavar: kutim gere arayot hen.
Abbaye la amar kerav ashe, la sevira leh ha derava. ella rava, may tama la amar kishmateh?
Lidvarav deabbaye kaamar, veleh la sevira leh.

Tanu rabbanan: shechitat kuti mutteret, bamme devarim amurim? kesheyyisrael omed al gabbav, aval ba umetzao sheshshachat – chotech kazzayit venoten lo, achalo – muttar leechol mishshechitato, veim lav – asur leechol mishshechitato.
Kayyotze bo, matza beyado

a: Dekureya shel tzipporim, kotea rosho shel echad mehen venoten lo. achalo – muttar leechol mishshechitato, veim lav – asur leechol mishshechitato.
Abbaye dayek meresha, rava dayek missefa. abbaye dayek meresha: tama deyisrael omed al gabbav, aval yotze venichnas – la.
Rava dayek missefa, tama deva umetzao sheshshachat, aval yotze venichnas – shappir dame.
Uleabbaye kashya sefa, amar lach: yotze venichnas name "ba umetzao" kare leh. ulerava kashya resha, amar lach: yotze venichnas name keomed al gabbav dame.
Kayyotze bo, matza beyado dekureya shel tzipporin, kotea rosho kulei. ammay? lechush dilma hay hu dahava shachet shappir!
Amar rav menashshe: (siman: machnis, izmel, bizcharim) bemachnisan tachat kenafav.
Vedilma simana hava yahev leh begavveh? amar rav mesharsheya: dimmasmes leh masmose.
Vedilma kasavri kutim: en shechita laof min hattora?
Uletamaych, shehiyyay, derasa, chalada, hagerama, veikkur – mi ketivan?
Ella, kevan deachziku behu – achziku behu. hacha name: kevan deachziku – achziku.
Veachzuk vela achzuk bidla ketiva, tannae hi, detanya: matztzat kuti mutteret, veadam yotze bah yede chovato bappesach.
Rabbi elazar oser, lefi sheen bekiin bedikduke mitzvot keyisrael.
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: kol mitzva shehecheziku bah kutim, harebe medakdekin bah yoter miyyisrael.

Amar mar: matztzat kuti mutteret, veadam yotze bah yede chovato bappesach. peshita! mahu detema: la bekii beshimmur, ka mashma lan. rabbi elazar oser, lefi sheen bekiin bedikduke mitzvot. kasavar: la bekii beshimmur.

Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: kol mitzva shehecheziku bah kutim, harebe medakdekin bah yoter miyyisrael. hayeynu tanna kamma? ikka benayyhu dichtiva vela achziku ba, tanna kamma savar: kevan dichtiva, af al gav dela achziku ba, verabban shimon ben gamliel savar: i achzuk – in, i la achzuk – la.
I hachi, "kol mitzva shehecheziku bah kutim" – "im hechziku" mibbee leh!
Ella, ikka benayyhu dela ketiva veachziku ba: tanna kamma savar, kevan dela ketiva, af al gav deachziku ba – name la; rabban shimon ben gamliel savar, kevan deachzuk – achzuk.
Gufa amar rava: yisrael meshummad, ochel nevelot leteavon – bodek sakkin venoten lo, umuttar leechol mishshechitato.
May tama? kevan deikka hettera veissura, la shavek hettera veachel issura.
I hachi, ki la bedak name, mitrach la tarach.
Amaru leh rabbanan lerava: tanya dimsayyay lach, chametzan shel ovre avera achar happesach
b: Muttar miyyad, mippene shehen machlifin.
Savruha, ha manni? rabbi yehuda hi, deamar: chametz achar happesach deorayyta, vekatane: mippene shehen machlifin, alma la shavek hettera veachel issura.
Mimmay? dilma rabbi shimon hi, deamar: chametz achar happesach derabbanan, vechi mekillinan – bidrabbanan, bidorayyta – la mekillinan!
Vetihve name rabbi shimon, mi katane "sheani omer hechlifu"? mippene shemmachlifin katane, devadday machlifin. uma bidrabbanan la shavek hettera veachel issura, bidorayyta lo kol shekken?

Lema mesayyay leh, hakkol shochatin, vaafillu kuti, vaafillu arel, vaafillu yisrael meshummad. hay arel hechi dame? illema metu echav mechamat milla – hay yisrael mealleya hu! ella peshita meshummad laarelut, veka savar meshummad ledavar echad la have meshummad lechol hattora kullah.
Ema sefa, vaafillu yisrael meshummad. hay meshummad hechi dame? i meshummad ledavar acher – hayeynu meshummad laarelut, ella lav meshummad leoto davar, vechidrava.

La, leolam ema lach: meshummad leoto davar la, may tama? kevan dedash beh – kehettera dame leh. ella meshummad laavoda zara, vechidrav anan, deamar rav anan amar shemuel: yisrael meshummad laavoda zara muttar leechol mishshechitato.

Gufa, amar rav anan amar shemuel: yisrael meshummad laavoda zara muttar leechol mishshechitato, shekken matzinu bihoshafat melech yehuda shennehena misseudat achav, shenneemar: "vayyizbach lo achav tzon uvakar larov velaam asher immo vaysitehu laalot el ramot gilad".
Vedilma mizbach zevach, mechal la achal! "vaysitehu" ketiv, vedilma bidvarim, en hasata bidvarim.
Vela? vehachtiv: "ki yesitcha achicha"! baachila uvishtiyya, vehachtiv: "vattesiteni vo levalleo chinnam"! lemala shane.

Vedilma mishta ishti, mechal la achal? may shena shetiyya – deamrinan: meshummad laavoda zara la have meshummad lechol hattora kullah, achila name – meshummad laavoda zara la have meshummad lechol hattora kullah.
Hachi hasheta? shetiyya – setam yenan hu, vaadayin lo neesar yenan shel goyim, aval achila – ema lach: meshummad laavoda zara have meshummad lechol hattora kullah.
Ibbaet ema: lav orcheh demalka mishteya bela mechla, veibbaet ema: "vayyizbach … vaysitehu" ketiv, bamma hesito – bizvicha.
Vedilma ovadya zevach? "larov" ketiv, ovadya la hava safek.
Vedilma shivat alafim zevuch, dichtiv: "vehisharti veyisrael shivat alafim kol habbirkayim asher lo charu labbaal vegomer", tammore havo mittammeri meizevel.
Vedilma gavre deachav havo meallu? la salka datach, dichtiv: "moshel makshiv al devar shaker kol meshartav reshaim".
Vedilma gavre dihoshafat name la havo meallu, zevuch gavre deachav achul gavre dihoshafat, zevuch ovadya achal yehoshafat.
La salka datach, middemoshel makshiv al devar shaker kol meshartav reshaim", ha lidvar emet – meshartav tzaddikim.
Vedilma zevuch gavre deachav achal achav vegavreh, zevuch gavre dihoshafat achal yehoshafat vegavreh?

a: La hava mefalleg nafsheh minneh, menalan? illema middichtiv "kamoni chamocha keammi cheammecha", ella meatta "kesusay kesusecha" hachi name? ella ma dehave assusecha teheve assusay, hachi name may dehave alach veillave ammach teheve alay veillave ammi.

Ella mehacha: "umelech yisrael vihoshafat melech yehuda yoshvim ish al kiso melubbashim begadim begoren petach shaar shomron". may goren? illema goren mammash, attu shaar shomron goren hava? ella ki goren, ditnan: sanhedrin hayta kachatzi goren agulla kede sheyyehu roin ze et ze.
Lema mesayyay leh, "vehaorvim meviim lo lechem uvasar babboker velechem uvasar baarev", veamar rav yehuda amar rav: mibbe tabbache deachav. al pi haddibbur shane.

May orvim? amar ravina: orvim mammash. amar leh rav adda bar minyome: vedilma tere gavre dehave shemayyhu orvim! mi la ketiv: "vayyahargu et orev betzur orev veet zeev vegomer"? amar leh: itremay milleta detarvayyhu hava shemayyhu orvim?

Vedilma al shem mekoman! mi la ketiv: "vaaram yatzu gedudim vayyishbu meeretz yisrael naara ketanna", vekashya lan: kare la "naara" vekare la "ketanna", veamar rabbi pedat: ketanna demin neoran! im ken "orviyyim" mibbee leh.

Lema mesayyay leh: hakkol shochatin, vaafillu kuti, vaafillu arel, vaafillu yisrael meshummad. hay arel hechi dame? illema shemmetu echav mechamat milla – hay yisrael mealleya hu! ella peshita meshummad laarelut.
Ema sefa: vaafillu yisrael meshummad, hechi dame? i meshummad ledavar echad – hayeynu meshummad laarelut, ella lav meshummad laavoda zara, vechidrav anan.
La, leolam emar lach: meshummad laavoda zara la, deamar mar: chamura avoda zara, shekkol hakkofer bah kemode bechol hattora kullah.
Ella meshummad leoto davar, vechidrava.

Metivi: "mikkem" – velo kullechem, lehotzi et hameshummad. "mikkem" – bachem chillakti velo beummot. "min habbehema" – lehavi bene adam sheddomim livhema. mikkan amru: mekabbelin korbenot mipposhe yisrael kede sheyyachzeru bahen bitshuva, chutz min hameshummad, umenassech et hayyayin, umechallel shabbatot befarhesya.
Ha gufa kashya, amrat: "mikkem" – velo kullechem, lehotzi et hameshummad, vahadar tane: mekabbelin korbanot mipposhe yisrael!
Ha la kashya, resha – meshummad lechol hattora kullah, metziata – meshummad ledavar echad.

Ema sefa: chutz min hameshummad umenassech et hayyayin umechallel shabbat befarhesya. hay meshummad hechi dame? i meshummad lechol hattora kullah – hayeynu resha, vei meshummad ledavar echad – kashya metziata.
Ella lav hachi kaamar: chutz min hameshummad lenassech et hayyayin ulechallel shabbatot befarhesya, alma meshummad laavoda zara have meshummad lechol hattora kullah, uteyuveta derav anan, teyuveta.
Veha mehacha nafka? mehatam nafka,
b: "Meam haaretz" – perat limshummad.
Rabbi shimon ben yose omer mishshum rabbi shimon: "asher lo teasena bishgaga veashem", hashshav midiato – mevi korban al shiggato, eno shav midiato – eno mevi korban al shiggato.
Veamrinan: may benayyhu? veamar rav hamenuna: meshummad leechol chelev vehevi korban al haddam ikka benayyhu.

Chada bechattat, vachada beola, utzerichi, dei ashmeinan chattat – mishshum dilchappara hu, aval ola dedoron hu – ema lekabbel minneh. vei ashmeinan ola – mishshum delav chiyyuva hu, aval chattat dechiyyuva hu – ema lekabbel minneh, tzericha.

Vechol hecha dichtiv behema, geriuta hi? vehachtiv "adam uvehema toshia Adonai", veamar rav yehuda amar rav: ellu bene adam shehen arumin bedaat, umesimin atzman kivhema! hatam ketiv "adam uvehema", hacha behema lechuddeh ketiv.
Vechol hecha dichtiv "adam uvehema" mealleyuta hi? veha ketiv: "vezarati et bet yisrael zera adam vezera behema"! hatam, ha challekeh kera, "zera adam" lechod vezera behema" lechod.
(Siman: niklaf.)

Amar rabbi chanan amar rabbi yaakov bar idde amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi mishshum bar kappara: rabban gamliel uvet dino nimnu al shechitat kuti vaasaruha. amar leh rabbi zera lerabbi yaakov bar idi: shemma lo shama rabbi ella besheen yisrael omed al gabbav? amar leh: dame hay merabbanan kidla gemiri inashe shemata, besheen yisrael omed al gabbav lememra bae?

Kabbela minneh o la kabbela minneh? ta shema, deamar rav nachman bar yitzchak amar rabbi assi: ani raiti et rabbi yochanan sheachal mishshechitat kuti, af rabbi assi achal mishshechitat kuti. vetahe ba rabbi zera: la shemia lehu, dei hava shemia lehu havo mekabbeli le, o dilma shemia lehu vela kabbeluha?

Hadar pashet lenafsheh: mistabbera dishmia lehu vela kabbeluha, dei salka datach la shemia lehu, vei hava shemia lehu havo mekabbeli le, hechi mistayyeya milleta lemechal issura? hasheta behemtan shel tzaddikim en hakkadosh baruch hu mevi takkala al yadan, tzaddikim atzman lo kol shekken!

a: Vei salka dataych la kabbela minneh, lishanne leh: kan kesheyyisrael omed al gabbav, kan kesheen yisrael omed al gabbav? ella lav shema minna kabbela minneh, shema minna.

Umay tama gezaru behu rabbanan? ki ha derabbi shimon ben elazar, shaddereh rabbi meir leetoye chamra mibbe chutae, ashkecheh hahu sava, amar leh: "vesamta sakkin beloecha im baal nefesh atta", halach rabbi shimon ben elazar vesipper devarim lifne rabbi meir, vegazar alehen.

May tama? amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: demut yona matzu lahen berosh har gerizim, shehayu ovdin otah. verabbi meir letameh, dechayesh lemiuta, vegazar rubba attu miuta. verabban gamliel uvet dino name kerabbi meir sevira lehu.
Peshateh dikra bemay ketiv? betalmid hayyoshev lifne rabbo, detane rabbi chiyyay: "ki teshev lilchom et moshel bin tavin et asher lefanecha vesamta sakkin beloecha im baal nefesh atta".
Im yodea talmid berabbo sheyyodea lehachazir lo taam – "bin", veim lav – "tavin et asher lefanecha vesamta sakkin beloecha", "im baal nefesh atta" – perosh hemennu.

Rabbi yitzchak ben yosef shaddereh rabbi avahu leetoye chamra mibbe chutae, ashkecheh hahu sava, amar leh: let kan shomre tora. halach rabbi yitzchak vesipper devarim lifne rabbi avahu, vehalach rabbi avahu vesipper devarim lifne rabbi amme verabbi assi, velo zazu mishsham ad sheasaum goyim gemurin.
Lemay? i lishchita veyen nesech, mehatam gezaru behu rabbanan! inhu gezur vela kabbilu minnayyhu, ato rabbi amme verabbi assi gezaru vekabbilu minnayyhu.
May goyim gemurin? amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: levattel reshut velitten reshut.
Vechidtanya: yisrael meshummad meshammer shabbatto bashshuk, mevattel reshut venoten reshut, vesheeno meshammer shabbatto bashshuk, eno mevattel reshut venoten reshut.
Mippene sheamru: yisrael noten reshut umevattel reshut, uvegoy ad sheyyiskor.
Ketzad? amar lo: "reshuti kenuya lach" "reshuti mevuttelet lach" – kana, veeno tzarich lizkot.

Rabbi zera verav assi ikkelau lefunedka deyae, ayyto lekammayyhu betzim hametzummakot beyayin. rabbi zera la achal, verav assi achal. amar leh rabbi zera lerav assi: vela chayesh mar letaarovet demay? amar leh: lav addatay.

Amar rabbi zera: efshar gazru al hattaarovet demay, umistayyeya milleta derav assi lemechal issura? hasheta behemtan shel tzaddikim en hakkadosh baruch hu mevi takkala al yadan, tzaddikim atzman lo kol shekken?

Nefak rabbi zera dak veashkach, ditnan: hallokeach yayin latet letoch hammureyays o letoch haalunetit, karshinin laasot mehen techinin, adashim laasot mehen resisin – chayyayv mishshum demay, veen tzarich lomar mishshum vadday.
Vehen atzman muttarin, mippene shehen taarovet.
Velo gazru al taarovet demay? vehatanya: hannoten lishchento issa leefot, ukedera levashshel – eno choshesh lisor vetavlin shebbah, lo mishshum sheviit velo mishshum maaser.
Veim amar lah: "asi li mishshellichi", choshesh lisor vetavlin shebbah mishshum sheviit umishshum maaser.
Shane hatam, dechevan dekaamar la "asi li mishshellichi", keman dearev beyadayim deme. rafram amar: shane seor vetavlin, diltama avid, vetama la batel.

Ulechallofe la chayyshinan? vehatnan: hannoten lachamoto – measser et shehu noten lah veet shehu notel mimmenna, mippene shechashudah machlefet hammitkalkel! hatam kidtanya tama, amar rabbi yehuda: rotze hi betakkanat bittah uvosha mechatanah.
b: Ulealma la chayyshinan? vehatnan: hannoten lappunedakit shello – measser et shehu noten lah veet shehu notel hemenna, mippene shechashudah machlefet! hatam name morya veamra: bar be rav lechol chammima, vaana echol karira.
Ulechallofe la chayyshinan? vehatanya: eshet chaver tochenet im eshet am haaretz bizman shehi temea, aval lo bizman shehi tehora.
Rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: af bizman shehi temea lo titchon, mippene shechavertah notenet lah veochelet.
Hasheta migzal gazla, challofe mibbaya? amar rav yosef: hatam name morya veamra "tora middeyasheh kaachel".
Heid rabbi yehoshua ben zeruz, ben chamiv shel rabbi meir, lifne rabbi al rabbi meir sheachal ale shel yarak bevet shean, vehittir rabbi et bet shean kullah al yado.
Chavru alav echav uvet aviv, amru lo: makom sheavotecha vaavot avotecha nahagu bo issur, atta tinhog bo hetter?

Derash lahen mikra ze: "vechittat nechash hannechoshet asher asa moshe ki ad hayyamim hahemma hayu vene yisrael mekatterim lo vayyikra lo nechushtan". efshar ba asa velo biaro, ba yehoshafat velo biaro? vahalo kol avoda zara shebbaolam asa vihoshafat biarum!

a: Ella makom hinnichu lo avotav lehitgadder bo, af ani makom hinnichu li avotay lehitgadder bo.
Mikkan letalmid chacham sheamar devar halacha, sheen mezichin oto, veamri lah: en maznichin oto, veamri lah: en mazchichin oto.

Man deamar "mezichin" – kedichtiv: "velo yizzach hachoshen", uman deamar "en maznichin" – dichtiv: "ki lo yiznach leolam Adonai", uman deamar "mazchichin" – ditnan: mishsherabbu zechuche hallev rabbu machlokot beyisrael.
Matkef la yehuda bereh derabbi shimon ben pazzi: umi ikka leman deamar devet shean lav meeretz yisrael hi? vehachtiv: "velo horish menashshe et bet shean veet benoteha veet tanach veet benoteha"!
Ishtemitteh ha deamar rabbi shimon ben elyakim, mishshum rabbi elazar ben pedat, sheamar mishshum rabbi elazar ben shammua: harebe kerakkim kevashum ole mitzrayim, velo kevashum ole bavel.
Vekasavar: kedushsha rishona kiddesha lishatah velo kiddesha leatid lavo, vehinnichum kede sheyyismechu alehen aniyyim bashsheviit.
Amar leh rabbi yirmeya lerabbi zera: veha rabbi meir ale bealma hu deachel! amar leh: meagudda achleh, utenan: yarak hanneegad mishsheyyeaged.
Vedilma lav addateh? hasheta, behemtan shel tzaddikim en hakkadosh baruch hu mevi takkala al yadan, tzaddikim atzman lo kol shekken!
Vedilma isser alehem mimmakom acher? lo nechshedu chaverim litrom shello min hammukkaf. vedilma natan enav betzad ze veachal betzad acher? amar leh: chazi man gavra rabba kamashed aleh.
May behemtan shel tzaddikim? derabbi pinchas ben yair hava kaazel lefidyon shevuyin, pega beh beginnay nahara.

Amar leh: ginnay, chalok li memecha veeevor bach! amar leh: atta holech laasot retzon konecha vaani holech laasot retzon koni, atta safek ose safek i atta ose, ani vadday ose. amar leh: im i atta cholek gozrani alecha shello yaavru becha mayim leolam. chalak leh.

Hava hahu gavra dahava dare chitte lefischa, amar leh chalok leh name lehay, divmitzva asek. chalak leh. hava hahu tayyaya dilvav bahadayyhu, amar leh chalok leh name lehay, dela lema: "kach osim livne leviyya", chalak leh.
Amar rav yosef: kamma nefish gavra mimmoshe veshittin ribbevavn, deillu hatam chad zimna, vehacha telata zimnin. vedilma hacha name chada zimna? ella kemoshe veshittin ribbevavn.
Ikkela lehahu ushepiza, remo leh seare lechamreh, la achal.
b: Chavtinhu, la achal. nakkerinhu, la achal. amar lehu: dilma la measseran? asserinhu, vaachal. amar: aniyyay zo holechet laasot retzon konah, veattem maachilin otah tevalim!
Umi michayyeyva? vehatnan: hallokeach lezera, velivhema, vekemach leorot, veshemen lanner, veshemen lasuch bo et hakkelim – patur mehaddemay.

Hatam ha ittemar ala, amar rabbi yochanan: lo shanu ella shellekachan mittechilla livhema, aval lekachan mittechilla leadam venimlach alehem livhema – chayyayv leasser. vehatanya: hallokeach perot min hashshuk laachila venimlach alehen livhema – hare ze lo yitten lo lifne behemto velo lifne behemat chavero ella im ken isser.
Shema rabbi, nefak leappeh, amar leh: retzoncha seod etzli? amar lo: hen. tzahavu panav shel rabbi.

Amar lo: kimdumme atta shemmuddar hanaa miyyisrael ani? yisrael kedoshim hen, yesh rotze veen lo, veyesh sheyyesh lo veeno rotze, uchetiv: "al tilcham et lechem ra ayin veal titav lematammotav ki kemo shaar benafsho ken hu echol ushete yomar lach velibbo bal immach", veatta rotze veyesh lecha.
Miha hasheta mesarhevna, divmilleta demitzva ka tarachna, ki hadarna atena ayelna legabbach.
Ki ata, itremi al behahu pitcha dahavo kayymin beh kudanyayta chivvavrata, amar: malach hammavet beveto shel ze vaani esod etzlo?
Shema rabbi nefak leappeh, amar leh: mezabbenyna lehu, amar leh: "velifne ivver lo titten michshol".
Mafkarna lehu, mappeshat hezzeka. akarna lehu, ikka tzaar baale chayyim. katelna lehu, ikka "bal tashchit".

Hava ka mevattesh beh tuva, geva tura benayyhu, bacha rabbi veamar: ma bechayyehen kach, bemitatan al achat kamma vechamma! deamar rabbi chama bar chanina: gedolim tzaddikim bemitatan yoter mibbechayyehen, shenneemar: "vayhi hem kovrim ish vehinne rau haggedud vayyashlichu et haish bekever elisha vayyelech vayyigga haish beatzmot elisha vaychi vayyakom al raglav".
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: vedilma lekayyome beh birketa deeliyyahu, dichtiv: "vihi na pi shenayim beruchacha elay"? amar leh: i hachi, hayeynu detanya: al raglav amad, uleveto lo halach!
Ella bema ikkayyaym? kidamar rabbi yochanan: sherippe tzaraat naaman, shehi shekula kemet, shenneemar: "al na tehi kammet".

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: lamma nikra sheman "yemim" – sheematam muttelet al habberiyyot, deamar rabbi chanina: miyyamay lo shealani adam al makkat pirda levana vechaya. veha kachazena dechaye! ema: "vechayayt", veha kachazena demittasse! dechivvavran resh karayyhu ka amrinan.

"En od millevaddo" – amar rabbi chanina: vaafillu keshafim. hahi itteta dahavat ka mehaddera lemishkal afra mittute kareh derabbi chanina, amar la: shekuli, la mistayyeya milletich, "en od milvaddo" ketiv. vehaamar rabbi yochanan: lamma nikra sheman keshafim – shemmachchishin pamalya shel mala! shane rabbi chanina dinfisha zechuteh.

Veamar rabbi chanina: en adam nokef etzbao millematta, ella im ken machrizin alav millemala, shenneemar: "meAdonai mitzade gever konanu veadam ma yavin darko". amar rabbi elazar: dam nikkuf meratztze kedam ola. amar rava: begudal yamin, uvenikkuf sheni, vehu dekaazel lidvar mitzva.
Amru alav al rabbi pinchas ben yair: miyyamav lo batza al perusa sheenah shello, umiyyom sheamad al dato lo nehena misseudat aviv.

a: Amar rabbi zera amar shemuel: libben sakkin veshachat bah – shechitato keshera, chiddudah kodem lelibbunah. vehaikka tzedadin? bet hashshechita mirvavch ravavch.
Ibbaya lehu: libben shappud vehikka bo, mishshum shechin niddon o mishshum michva niddon?
Lemay nafka minna – lechidtanya: shechin umichva metammein beshavua echad, bishne simanin – besear lavan uvefisyon, velamma chillekan hakkatuv? lomar sheen mitztarfin ze im ze.

Vetanya: ezehu shechin veezehu michva? laka beetz, beeven, begefet, bechamme teverya, uvechol davar shello ba mechamat haur, leetoye avar meikkaro – zehu shechin. veezehu michva? nichva begachelet, beremetz, besid roteach, begifsis roteach, uvechol davar habba mechamat haur, leetoye chamme haur – zo hi michva.
Vetanya: shechin umichva, im shechin kodem lammichva – bittel michva et hashshechin, veim michva kodemet lashshechin – bittel shechin et hammichva.
Vehacha, hechi dame? kegon dahava beh chatzi geris shechin meikkara, velibben shappud vehikka bo, unefak beh chatzi geris acher.
May chavta? kadem veate havela umevattel leh lechavta, vehave leh shechin umichva, vela mitztarfin; o dilma havela kadem, veate chavta umevattel leh lehavela, vehave leh shechin ushechin, umitztaref?
Ta shema, deamar rabbi zera amar shemuel: libben sakkin veshachat bah – shechitato keshera, chiddudah kodem lelibbunah. alma chavta kadem! chiddud shane.
Ta shema: libben shappud vehikka bo – niddon mishshum michvat esh, alma chavta kadem! hatam name, devarzey mivraz, dehayynu chiddud.
Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: sakkin shel avoda zara muttar lishchot bah, veasur lachtoch bah basar. muttar lishchot bah – mekalkel hu, veasur lachtoch bah basar – metakken hu.
Amar rava: peamim shehashshochet asur – bimsukkenet, umechattech muttar – beatme dekayyman lekurebana.
Vetippok leh mishshum shamnunit deissura!
b: Bachadasha.

Chadasha, ben lerabbi yishmael ben lerabbi akiva, meshammeshe avoda zara hen, umeshammeshe avoda zara enan asurin ad sheyyeavedu! ibbaet ema, difsak beh gevavza laavoda zara, veibbaet ema, bishana shellibbenah baur.
Ittemar: hashshochet besakkin shel goyim, rav amar: kolef, verabba bar bar chana amar: mediach. lema beha kamippalgi, demar savar: bet hashshechita tzonen, umar savar: bet hashshechita roteach.
La, dechulle alma bet hashshechita roteach hu; man deamar kolef – shappir, uman deamar mediach – ayyeyde ditridi simanin leappoke dam la bali.
Ikka deamri, dechulle alma bet hashshechita tzonen. man deamar mediach – shappir, man deamar kolef – aggav ducheka desakkina bala.
Sakkin terefa, peligi ba rav acha veravina, chad amar: bechammin, vechad amar: betzonen, vehilcheta: afillu betzonen, vei ikka belita difrasa lemichpereh, la tzerich.
Uleman deamar bechammin, may tama? mishshum deka vala issura? dehettera name bala ever min hachay! emat bala? lechi chayyma. emat ka chayyma? lechi gamra shechita, hahi shata hettera hava.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: hattabbach tzarich shelosha sakkinin, achat sheshshochet bah, veechad shemmechattech bah basar, veechad shemmechattech bah chalavim.
Velitakken leh chada, velichtoch bah basar, vahadar lichtoch ba chalavim? gezera shemma yachtoch chalavim veachar kach basar. hasheta name michallaf leh! kevan deatzrechinhu tere – it leh hekkera.

Veamar rav yehuda amar rav: hattabbach tzarich shene kelim shel mayim, echad shemmediach bo basar, veechad shemmediach bo chalavim. venitakken leh chada, unediach bo basar vahadar nediach bo chalavim? gezera shemma yadiach chalavim veachar kach basar. hasheta name michallefi leh? kevan deatzrechinneh tarte it leh hekkera.
Amar ammemar mishshemeh derav pappa: la lischof inish kafle illave bisra, dedaev tarba uvala bisra.
I hachi, ki teritzi name daev tarba uvala bisra? kerama mafsek mittattay! i hachi

a: Meillay name kerama ikka? ayyeyde dimmashmesha yeda detabbacha mippattat.

Veamar rav yehuda amar rav: talmid chacham tzarich sheyyilmod shelosha devarim: ketav, shechita, umila. verav chananya bar shelemya mishshemeh derav amar: af kesher shel tefillin, uvirkat chatanim, vetzitzit. veiddach – hane shechichan.
Veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: kol tabbach sheeno yodea hilchot shechita asur leechol mishshechitato, veellu hen hilchot shechita: shehiyyay, derasa, chalada, hagerama, veikkur.

May ka mashma lan? kullehu teninhu! la tzericha, sheshshachat lefanenu shetayim veshalosh peamim ushechat shappir; mahu detema: middeiddach shechat shappir, hay name shechat shappir, ka mashma lan: kevan dela gemir, zimnin deshahe vedares vela yada.
Veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: hattabbach tzarich sheyyivdok bassimanim leachar shechita. amar rav yosef: af anan name tenena, rabbi shimon omer: im shaha kede bikkur. may lav kede bikkur simanin?
Amar leh abbaye: la, hachi amar rabbi yochanan: kede bikkur chacham. im ken, natatta devarecha leshiurim! ella, kede bikkur tabbach chacham.
Lo badak, may? rabbi eliezer ben antignos mishshum rabbi elazar berabbi yannay amar: terefa, vaasura baachila. bematnita tana: nevela, umetammea bemassa.
Bemay kamippalgi? bidrav huna, deamar: behema bechayyeha bechezkat issur omedet, ad sheyyivvada lach bamme nishchata. nishchata – hare hi bechezkat hetter, ad sheyyivvada lach bamme nitrefa.
Mar savar: bechezkat issur kayyma, vehasheta meta hi; umar savar: bechezkat issur amrinan, bechezkat tumea la amrinan.

Gufa, amar rav huna: behema bechayyeha bechezkat issur omedet ad sheyyivvada lach bamme nishchata, nishchata – bechezkat hetter omedet ad sheyyivvada lach bamme nitrefa. velema: "nishchata huttera"! ha ka mashma lan, deaf al gav deityelid ba reuta.
Kediva minneh rabbi abba merav huna: ba zeev venatal bene meayim, mahu?
Natal?! ha letanhu, ella nakav bene meayim mahu? nakav?! ha ka chazenan dehu nakvinhu! ella netalan vehechziran keshehen nekuvin, mahu? mi chayyshinan shemma bimkom nekev nakav, o la?
Amar leh: en choshshin shemma bimkom nekev nakav.
Etiveh: raa tzippor hamenakker bitena veachbar hamenakker baavattichim,
b: Choshshin shemma bimkom nekev nakav.
Amar leh: mi ka medammet issura lesakkanta? sakkana shane! amar leh rava: may shena? sefek sakkanta lechumera? sefek issura name lechumera!
Amar leh abbaye: vela shane ben issura lesakkanta? veha illu sefek tumea birshut harabbim – sefeko tahor, veillu sefek mayim megullin – asurin!
Amar leh: hatam hilcheta gemiri la missota, ma sota birshut hayyachid – af tumea birshut hayyachid.
Metiv rav shimi: sheretz befi chuleda, vechuleda mehallechet al gabbe kikkarot shel teruma – safek naga, safek lo naga – sefeko tahor, veillu sefek mayim megullin asurin!
Hatam name hilcheta gemiri la missota: ma sota davar sheyyesh bah daat lishshael, af hacha name davar sheyyesh bo daat lishshael.
Amar rav ashe, ta shema: tzelochit shehinnichah megulla uva umetzaah mechussa – temea, sheani omer: adam tame nichnas lesham vechissah.
Hinnichah mechussa uva umetzaah megulla, im yechola chuleda lishtot mimmenna, o nachash ledivre rabban gamliel, o sheyyarad bah tal ballayla – pesula.
Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: ma taam?

a: Mippene sheddarkan shel sheratzim legallot, veen darkan lechassot.
I name, tama dehinnichah megulla uva umetzaah mechussa, mechussa uva umetzaah megulla, ha metzaah kema shehinnichah – la tumea ikka vela pesula ikka.
Veillu sefek mayim megullim asurin, shema minna: chamira sakkanta meissura, shema minna.

Tenan hatam: shelosha mashkin asurin mishshum gilluy – mayim, veyayin, vechalav. kamma yishhu veyihyu asurin? kede sheyyetze harachash mimmakom karov veyishte. vechamma makom karov? amar rav yitzchak bereh derav yehuda: kede sheyyetze mittachat ozen keli veyishte.
Yishte? ha ka chaze leh! ella, yishte veyachazor lechoro.
Ittemar: hashshochet besakkin venimtzet peguma, amar rav huna: afillu shibber bah atzamot kol hayyom – pesula, chayyshinan shemma baor nifgema. verav chisda amar: keshera, shemma beetzem nifgema.
