Bishlama rav huna kishmateh, ella rav chisda may tama? amar lach: etzem – vadday pogem, or – safek pogem safek la pogem, have safek uvadday, veen safek motzi mide vadday.

Metiv rava lesayyoeh lerav huna: taval veala, venimtza alav davar chotzetz, af al pi shennitassek beoto hammin kol hayyom kullo – lo alta lo tevila, ad sheyyomar: "bari li shello haya alay kodem lachen". veha hacha, devadday taval, safek hava aleh safek la hava aleh, vekaate safek umotzi mide vadday!
Shane hatam, deikka lememar: haamed tame al chezkato, veemar lo taval.
Hacha name, haamed behema al chezkatah, veemar lo nishchata! hare shechuta lefanecha.
Hacha name, hare taval lefanecha! ha ityelida beh reuta.
Hacha name ityelida ba reuta! sakkin itreay, behema la itreay.
Metivi: shachat et havveshet veachar kach nishmeta haggargeret – keshera, nishmeta haggargeret veachar kach shachat et havveshet – pesula.
Shachat et havveshet (venimtza) [venimtzet] haggargeret shemuta, veeno yodea im kodem shechita nishmeta im leachar shechita nishmeta, ze haya maase, veamru: kol sefek bishchita pasul.
Kol safek bishchita leetoye may? lav leetoye kehay gavvna? la, leetoye safek shaha, safek daras.
b: Umay shena? hatam ityelida ba reuta bivhema, hacha sakkin itreay, behema la itreay.

Vehilcheta kevavteh derav huna, keshello shibber bah etzem. vehilcheta kevavteh derav chisda, kesheshshibber bah etzem. mikkelal derav chisda af al gav dela shibber bah etzem? ella bemay ippegim? ema: beetzem demafreket ippegim.
Hava ovada vetaraf rav yosef ad telesar chevata, keman? kerav huna, vaafillu bekammayyta? la, kerav chisda, ulevar mikkammayyta.
Veibbaet ema: leolam kerav huna, dei kerav chisda, mikkede mitla talenan, mimmay divetzem demafreket dekammayyta ippegim? dilma beetzem demafreket devatrayyta ippegim!
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: rav kahana matzrech bedikuta ben kol chada vachada. keman? kerav huna, ulemifsal kammayyta? la, kerav chisda, uleachshore batrayyta.
I hachi, tive name bedikat chacham! ed echad neeman beissurin. i hachi, meikkara name la! haamar rabbi yochanan: lo amru lehareot sakkin lechacham ella mippene kevodo shel chacham.
Mena ha milleta daamur rabbanan: oke milleta achezkeh?

Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan, amar kera "veyatza hakkohen min habbayit el petach habbayit vehisgir et habbayit shivat yamim", dilma addenafek veate betzar leh shiura! ella lav mishshum deamrinan oke achezkeh.
Matkef la rav acha bar yaakov: vedilma kegon sheyyatza derech achorav, deka chaze leh ki nafek!

Amar leh abbaye: shete teshuvot baddavar, chada, ditzia derech achorav lo shemah yetzia, veod, achore haddelet may ikka lememar? vechi tema defatach beh kavvevta – vehatnan: bayit afel en potchin bo challonot lirot et nigo!

Amar leh rava: dekaamrat yetzia derech achorav lo shemah yetzia – kohen gadol beyom hakkippurim yochiach, dichtiv beh yetzia, utenan: yatza uva lo derech kenisato. udekaamrat bayit afel en potchin bo challonot lirot et nigo – hane mille hecha dela ittachzak, aval hecha deittachzak – ittachzak.
Tanya dela kerav acha bar yaakov, "veyatza hakkohen min habbayit" – yachol yelech letoch beto veyasgir? talmud lomar: "el petach habbayit".
I "petach habbayit", yachol yaamod tachat hammashkof veyasgir? talmud lomar: "min habbayit" – ad sheyyetze min habbayit kullo. ha ketzad? omed betzad hammashkof umasgir.
Uminnayin sheim halach letoch beto vehisgir, o sheamad betoch habbayit vehisgir, shehesgero musegar? talmud lomar: "vehisgir et habbayit", mikkol makom.
Verav acha bar yaakov,

a: Kegon dekayymi dara degavre veamri: kidkae kae.
Mena ha milleta daamur rabbanan: zil batar rubba? menalan?! dichtiv: "achare rabbim lehattot".
Rubba deita kamman, kegon tesha chanuyot, vesanhedrin – la ka mibbaya lan.
Ki ka mibbaya lan, rubba deleteh kamman, kegon katan uketanna, menalan?
Amar rabbi elazar (siman zeman shevach mechannesh):
Atya meresha shel ola, deamar kera: "venittach otah lintacheha", otah lintacheha, velo netacheha lintachim, venechush shemma nikkav kerum shel moach? ella lav mishshum deamrinan zil batar rubba.
Mimmay? dilma defale leh uvadek leh, vei mishshum "otah lintacheha" velo netacheha lintachim – hane mille hecha dechatech leh ligmare, aval hecha delayif let lan ba.
Mar bereh deravina amar: atya mishshevirat etzem befesach, deamar rachamana: "veetzem lo tishberu vo", venechush shemma nikkav kerum shel moach? ella lav mishshum deamrinan: zil batar rubba.
Mimmay? dilma demannach gumarta aleh, vekale leh, uvadek leh, detanya: hamechattech begidim vehassoref baatzamot – en bo mishshum shevirat etzem.
Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: atya mealya, deamar rachamana: "chelbo haalya temima", velechush shemma nifseka chut hashshidra? ella lav mishshum deamrinan: zil batar rubba.
Vechi tema demittattay pasek la, "leummat heatze" amar rachamana, mekom shehakkelayot yoatzot.
Mimmay? dilma defatach la uvadek la, vei mishshum "temima" – hane mille hecha dechatcha ligmare, aval hecha delayif – let lan ba.
Rav sheshet bereh derav idi amar: atya meegla arufa, deamar rachamana: "haarufa" – keshehi shelema tehve, velechush dilma terefa hi! ella lav mishshum deamrinan: zil batar rubba.
Vechi tema, may nafka minna, ha amri deve rabbi yannay: kappara ketiv bah kekadashim.

Rabba bar rav shela amar: atya mippara adumma, deamar rachamana "veshachat… vesaraf", ma shechitatah keshehi shelema, af serefatah keshehi shelema, velechush dilma terefa hi! ella lav mishshum deamrinan: zil batar rubba.
Vechi tema, may nafka minna? "chattat" karyay rachamana.
Rav acha bar yaakov amar: atya missair hammishtalleach, derachamana amar: "velakach et shene hasseirim", sheyyehu shenehem shavim, velechush
b: Dilma chad minnayyhu terefa hu? ella lav mishshum deamrinan: zil batar rubba.
Vechi tema, may nafka lan minna? ha en goral kovea laazazel ella bedavar harauy lashshem. vechi tema devadkinan leh, vehatnan: lo haya maggia lemachatzit hehar ad shennaase evarim evarim.
Rav mari amar: atya mimmakke aviv veimmo, deamar rachamana katleh, velechush dilma lav aviv hu? ella lav mishshum deamrinan: zil batar rubba, verov beilot achar habbaal.
Mimmay? dilma kegon shehayu aviv veimmo chavushim bevet haasurin! afillu hachi, en appotroppos laarayot.
Rav kahana amar: atya mehoreg et hannefesh, deamar rachamana: katleh, velechush dilma terefa hava? ella lav mishshum deamrinan: zil batar rubba.
Vechi tema devadkinan leh, ha ka minnavvavl, vechi tema mishshum ibbud neshama dehay – ninavvevleh, venechush shemma bimkom sayif nekev hava.
Ravina amar: atya meedim zommin, deamar rachamana: "vaasitem lo kaasher zamam vegomer", velechush dilma hach deashidu beh terefa hava? ella lav mishshum deamrinan: zil batar rubba.
Vechi tema devadkinan leh, vehatanya: berabbi omer: lo hargu – neheragin, hargu – en neheragin.
Rav ashe amar: atya mishshechita atzmah, deamar rachamana: shechot veechol, velechush shemma bimkom nekev ka shachet? ella lav mishshum deamrinan: zil batar rubba.
Amar rav ashe: amrita lishmata kammeh derav kahana, veamri lah rav kahana kammeh derav shimi, vaamar leh: vedilma hecha deefshar – efshar, hecha dela efshar – la efshar.
Dei la tema hachi, lerabbi meir dechayesh lemiuta, hachi name dela achel bisra? vechi tema hachi name,

a: Pesach vekadashim may ikka lememar? ella hecha deefshar – efshar, hecha dela efshar – la efshar. hacha name, hecha deefshar – efshar, hecha dela efshar – la efshar.
Amar rav nachman amar rav: raa echad sheshshachat, im raahu mittechilla vead sof – muttar leechol mishshechitato, veim lav – asur leechol mishshechitato.
Hechi dame? i deyada digmir, lema li raa? vei deyada dela gemir, peshita!
Veella, dela yeda i gemir i la gemir, lema: rov metzuyin etzel shechita mumechin hen.
Mi la tanya: hare shemmatza tarnegolet shechuta bashshuk, o sheamar lishlucho "tze shechot", vehalach umatza shachut – chezkato shachut.
Alma amrinan: rov metzuyin etzel shechita mumechin hen. hacha name lema: rov metzuyin etzel shechita mumechin hen!
Leolam deyada dela gemir, uchegon dishchat kamman chad siman shappir. mahu detema: middehay shappir hach name shappir, ka mashma lan: hay itremoye itremi leh, iddach – shemma shaha shemma daras.

Bea minneh rav dimi bar yosef merav nachman: haomer lishlucho "tze ushechot", vehalach umatza shachut, mahu? amar lo: chezkato shachut. haomer lishlucho "tze uterom", vehalach umatza tarum, may? amar leh: en chezkato tarum.
Ma nafshach, i chazaka shaliach ose shelichuto – afillu teruma name, vei en chazaka shaliach ose shelichuto – afillu shechita name la.

Amar leh: lechi techul ala kora demilcha, leolam en chazaka shaliach ose shelichuto, ushechita – i name dilma inash acharina shema vaazal shechat – rov metzuyin etzel shechita mumechin hen. teruma – dilma inash acharina shema vaazal teram, have leh torem shello middaat, vehattorem shello middaat – en terumato teruma.

Lema: rov metzuyin etzel shechita mumechin hen tannae hi? detanya: hare sheavdu lo gedayav vetarnegolav vehalach umetzaan shechutim – rabbi yehuda oser, rabbi chanina beno shel rabbi yose haggelili mattir. amar rabbi: nirin devarim shel rabbi yehuda shemmetzaan beashpa, vedivre rabbi chanina beno shel rabbi yose haggelili shemmetzaan bevayit.
May lav beha kamippalgi, demar savar: amrinan rov metzuyin etzel shechita mumechin hen, umar savar: la amrinan rov metzuyin etzel shechita mumechin hen?

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: la, dechulle alma rov metzuyin etzel shechita mumechin hen, uvevayit – dechulle alma la peligi dishre, beashpa shebbashshuk – dechulle alma la peligi deasur, ki peligi beashpa shebbabbayit: mar savar adam asuy lehattil nivlato beashpa shebbabbayit, umar savar en adam asuy lehattil nivlato beashpa shebbabbayit.
Amar mar, amar rabbi: nirin divre rabbi yehuda shemmetzaan beashpa. may ashpa? illema ashpa shebbeshuk – ha amrat dechulle alma la peligi deasur! ella lav peshita beashpa shebbabbayit.

Ema sefa, vedivre rabbi chanina beno shel rabbi yose haggelili shemmetzaan bevayit. may bayit? illema bayit mammash – haamrat dechulle alma la peligi dishre! ella peshita beashpa shebbabbayit. kashya derabbi adderabbi!
b: Hachi kaamar: nirin divre rabbi yehuda lerabbi chanina beno shel rabbi yose haggelili beashpa shebbashshuk, sheaf rabbi chanina beno shel rabbi yose haggelili lo nechlak alav ella beashpa shebbabbayit, aval beashpa shebbashshuk mode leh, venirin kulei.
Chutz mecheresh shote vekatan, shemma yekalkelu et shechitatan. "shemma kilkelu" la katane, ella "shemma yekalkelu". amar rava: zot omeret en mosrin lahen chullin lechattechilla.
Vechullan sheshshachatu vaacherim roim otam, shechitatan keshera. man tena dela baenan kavvavna lishchita?

Amar rava: rabbi natan hi, detane oshaya zeera demin chavrayya: zarak sakkin lenootzah bakkotel, vehalcha veshachata kedarkah – rabbi natan machshir, vachachamim poslin. hu tane la, vehu amar la: halacha kerabbi natan.
Veha baenan molich umevi? shehalcha uvaa kedarkah.
Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba, bae rabbi yochanan: katan yesh lo machshava, o en lo machshava?
Amar leh rabbi amme: vetibbee leh maase? may shena maase dela ka mibbaya leh – ditnan: "yesh lahen maase"? machshava name la tibbee leh, ditnan: "en lahen machshava"!
Ditnan: haallon, veharimmon, vehaegoz shechakakum tinokot lamod bahen afar, o shehitkinum lechaf moznayim – temein, mippene sheyyesh lahen maase,
